programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague / Košarka - Euroleague
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its association "Eurologue Basketball". The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition is decided on the final tournament called "Final Four". The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja "Eurolegaue Basketball". Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva "Final Four". Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: After Salvador reports Violeta's news of Davi's escape from prison, Davi escapes from the estate in fear that they do not recognize him. But he gives up when he remembers the danger of Isador for the úrsula and Joaquim. Olívia does not accept Felicidade's resignation and organizes a rebellion at the factory and stops all the weaving machines. Felicidade does not receive the rights he deserves, and Violeta and Isador are moved by Felicidade's situation and give her the right to maternity leave. Bento and Letícia get married before his departure to war. Bento and Lorenzo go to military training. In order to avoid an altercation with Isador, Joaquim listens to his mother's advice and suggested that they miss Olívi to the supervisor. Violeta and Isadora are surprised by Rafael's humility because of life in the countryside, so they decide to invite him to dinner to get to know him better. And that brings Rafael to a difficult situation. / Nakon što Salvador javi Violeti vijest o Davijevom bijegu iz zatvora, Davi bježi s imanja u strahu da ga ne prepoznaju. Ali odustane kad se sjeti opasnosti u kojoj se nalazi Isadora zbog Úrsule i Joaquima. Olívia ne prihvaća Felicidadeinu ostavku i organizira pobunu u tvornici i zaustavi sve tkalačke strojeve. Felicidade ne dobije prava koja zaslužuje, a Violeta i Isadora su ganute Felicidadeinom situacijom i daju joj pravo na porodiljni dopust. Bento i Letícia se vjenčaju prije njegova odlaska u rat. Bento i Lorenzo odlaze na vojnu obuku. Kako bi izbjegao svađu s Isadorom, Joaquim posluša majčin savjet i predloži da promaknu Olíviju u nadzornicu. Violeta i Isadora se iznenade Rafaelovom poniznošću zbog života na selu, pa ga odluče pozvati na večeru kako bi ga bolje upoznale. A to Rafaela dovodi u tešku situaciju.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Simone tings to Justin's will. Everyone remembers her previous attempts to kill him, and they suspect that she might be guilty of his death. Police questioned her where she was on the day of his death, and she refuses to cooperate. Lalá tries to reconcile with Valdemar, but he refuses it. / Simone podere Justinovu oporuku. Svi se prisjećaju njezinih prijašnjih pokušaja da ga ubije, te slute da je možda ona kriva za njegovu smrt. Policija je ispituje gdje je bila na dan njegove smrti, a ona odbija suradnju. Lalá se pokušava pomiriti s Valdemarom, ali on je odbije.

programme.title: With our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: We bring the emotional personal story of writer Marko Gregur about the difficult path to parenting, and Dubravka Marusic of the Adopta Association will speak about the situation with the adoption of children in Croatia! Our music guest is Marko Skugor. One of the most beautiful Croatian votes is the new single "Vira and Nevira". It is open until 23 November lasts for Dora for Dora Tomislav Štengl will tell us all about applications and novelties. We also say goodbye to the music legend of Halid Beslic, who leaves behind eternal hits and sadness in the hearts of his loyal fans. / Donosimo emotivnu osobnu priču pisca Marka Gregura o teškom putu do roditeljstva, a o situaciji s posvajanjem djece u Hrvatskoj govorit će Dubravka Marušić iz udruge Adopta! Naš glazbeni gost je Marko Škugor. Jedan od najljepših hrvatskih glasova predstavlja novi singl "Vira i nevira". Ali piramide su samo dio fascinantne i zagonetne povijesti Starog Egipta, koju nakon cjelonoćnog putovanja vlakom nastavlja istraživati u Luxoru, gradu u kojem su duhovi faraona itekako prisutni. Kristijan u Luxoru otkriva niz impresivnih, golemih hramova sa svojim neobičnim pričama. Privučen neodoljivim šarmom zalaska Sunca na Nilu, noć dočeka ploveći ovom velikom rijekom. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The Bettany's trip starts in one of the most tallest cities of the subcontinent _ Varanasia. Fatehpur Skri is conceived as an imperial capital of the Mogulski Carkarkar. His new city was bigger than London, but he was inhabited only 14 years. He goes to the boat to the Lake Palace, an extraordinary royal residence located on the island in the shining Lake Pichola. The amazing palace is decorated with massive marble slabs with inserted rubes, onyx, jade and carnella _ that allegedly served as inspiration for decorations within that mahala. The legendary treasure and monument of love, Taj Mahal, was built in 1632. As a tomb for a favorite woman of the Mogulski Emperor Shah Restrained, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany goes out in front of a bright white marble structure to reveal the intriguing secret _ how they are neglected and oversetting the world-famous mausoleum once a haven of love and loss. In the city of Amritsar, the amazing beautiful temple creates an illusion to hover at the center of St. Lake. Gurudwara is the latest pilgrimage place for Sikhe, but the temple is open for pilgrims of all faiths and offers food to each visitors from the largest free kitchen in the world. / Bettanyno putovanje počinje u jednom od najsvetijih gradova potkontinenta _ Varanasiju. Hindusi vjeruju da smrt u Varanasiju i kremiranje na obalama rijeke Ganges omogućuje da se ciklus ponovnog rađanja prekine, a spasenje ostvari. Fatehpur Sikri zamišljen je kao carska prijestolnica mogulskog cara Akbara. Njegov novi grad bio je veći od Londona, no bio je naseljen samo 14 godina. Bettany istražuje njegove prazne palače, hramove i privatne paviljone _ istovremeno otkrivajući jedinstven svjetonazor čovjeka koji ih je izgradio. Bettany obilazi palače Udaipura. Odlazi čamcem do Jezerske palače, izvanredne kraljevske rezidencije smještene na otoku u blistavom jezeru Pichola. Zadivljujuća palača ukrašena je masivnim mramornim pločama s umetnutim rubinima, oniksom, žadom i karneolom _ koji su navodno poslužili kao inspiracija za ukrase unutar Taj Mahala. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany izlazi ispred građevine od blistavo bijelog mramora kako bi otkrila intrigantnu tajnu _ kako su zapušteni i zarasli vrtovi koji okružuju svjetski poznati mauzolej nekoć bili utočišta ljubavi i gubitka. U gradu Amritsar zadivljujuće lijepi hram stvara iluziju da lebdi u središtu svetog jezera. programme.desc: Can school endure 21 days without smartphones? We follow the social experiment that explores the actual impact of smartphones on young people. This two -piece documentary deals with the current question of the influence of smartphones on the baby's brain and behavior. The problem of increasing young people's dependencies about smartphones exceeds geographical and cultural barriers and encourages a discussion of a suitable age to access this technology. The authors of the film, Matt and Emma Willis, join forces with Stanway school in Colchester. Ovaj dvodijelni dokumentarac bavi se aktualnim pitanjem utjecaja pametnih telefona na dječji mozak i ponašanje. Problem sve veće ovisnosti mladih o pametnim telefonima prelazi zemljopisne i kulturne barijere te potiče raspravu o prikladnoj dobi za pristup toj tehnologiji. programme.title: Put rijeka
programme.desc: The episode displays the Neretva River and its importance to grow tangerine in the valley. After graduating from the Academy of Arts in Tirana, 15 years ago he came to Zagreb to dig a way to a better life. Zlatna lopata naziv je monodrame Teatra Mergimtari kojom Leonard pronosi diljem Hrvatske i Europe vlastitu glumačku vještinu, ali i albanski jezik kojim se služi na pozornici. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The exceptional capital of the Empire of Vijayanagar from the 14th century includes the ruins of the palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonnades, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special carriage streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. / Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. Sveti plesači obilaze sela i hramove, odjeveni u bogate kostime i živopisno obojenih tijela, te utjelovljuju bogove i boginje u glazbenim prizorima koji traju cijelu noć. Bettanyna avantura na Malabarskoj obali završava na jednom od poznatih brodova za stanovanje. Ploveći kanalima ona istražuje drevnu trgovinu začinima koja je oblikovala krajolik i povijest Indije.

programme.desc: Action / Distopia, ZF. It's been a decade since John Connor (Nick Stahl) helped prevent the Day of Judgment _ The day Skynet's advanced network of machines had to acquire self -awareness and destroy humanity. But this time Connor is not the only target on Skynet's list for the shooting _ veterinarian Kate Brewster (Claire Danes), who has nothing to suspect, awaits the collision of an ancient past, the present that promises and the unimaginable future ... but only if he manages to draw an unstoppable T-X terminal. When Connor and Kate realize that their daytime day is dizzying _ only three hours divide from the end of the world _ Their only hope for survival is a redeemed T-100 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), Connor's mysterious _ and now an outdated _ former assassination. Together they have to beat the technologically superior T-X and prevent the threat of the Day of Judgment ... or face the fall of the civilization we know it. / Akcijski / distopija, ZF. Prošlo je desetljeće otkad je John Connor (Nick Stahl) pomogao spriječiti Sudnji dan _ dan kada je Skynetova napredna mreža strojeva trebala steći samosvijest i uništiti čovječanstvo. Ali 29. kolovoza 1997. došao je i prošao bez incidenata, unatoč dvama Skynetovim neuspjelim pokušajima da ubije Connora i započne rat protiv čovječanstva. Sada 22-godišnjak, Connor živi izvan sustava _ nema dom, nema kreditne kartice, nema telefon i nema posao. Nema zapisa o njegovu postojanju. Nema šanse da ga Skynet pronađe. Sve dok... ...iz sjena budućnosti ne dođe T-X (Kristianna Loken), Skynetov dosad najnapredniji stroj za ubijanje. Poslan iz budućnosti kako bi dovršio posao koji je njegov prethodnik, T-1000, nije uspio obaviti, taj je stroj nemilosrdan koliko je njegova ljudska maska privlačna. I eksponencijalno je moćniji, opasniji i destruktivniji od svakog terminatora koji je došao prije njega. Ali ovoga puta Connor nije jedina meta na Skynetovoj listi za odstrel _ veterinarku Kate Brewster (Claire Danes), koja ništa ne sluti, čeka sudar davne prošlosti, sadašnjosti koja obećava i nezamislive budućnosti... ali samo ako uspije umaknuti nezaustavljivu terminatoru T-X. programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: A biographical music film is accompanied by American singer's life, Arethe Franklin, from her childhood when she sang in a choir at her father's church to her rise to the status of an international superstar. It is a true story of the life path of the music icon and her effort to find herself and eventually become Queen Soul. / Biografski glazbeni film prati život američke pjevačice Arethe Franklin, od djetinjstva kad je kao djevojčica pjevala u zboru u očevoj crkvi pa do njezina uspona do statusa međunarodne superzvijezde. To je istinita priča o životnom putu glazbene ikone i njezinom nastojanju da pronađe sebe i na koncu postane kraljica soula.

programme.title: Slava ubija
programme.desc: On Wednesday, April 20, 2016, Dr. Michael Schulenberg gives Prince therapy because of the symptoms of the abstinence crisis. On the same evening, Prince's representative contacts California specialist in Dr. Howard Kornfeld's addiction disease. He is asked to help Prince, who suffers from heavy dependence on opioids. Dr. Kornfeld cannot come immediately and therefore send his son Andrew. Andrew Kornfeld and longtime Prince's friends Kirk Johnson and Meron Kekura come to Paisley Park the next day to look for Prince. To his horror, he finds his lifeless body on the elevator floor. Prince never saved. He always did his best. His life was like a party, but fun doesn't last forever. / U srijedu, 20. travnja 2016., dr. Michael Schulenberg daje Princeu terapiju zbog simptoma apstinencijske krize. Iste večeri Princeov predstavnik kontaktira kalifornijskog specijalista za bolesti ovisnosti dr. Howarda Kornfelda. Od njega se traži da pomogne Princeu, koji pati od teške ovisnosti o opioidima. Dr. Kornfeld ne može odmah doći i zato šalje svog sina Andrewa. Andrew Kornfeld te dugogodišnji Princeovi prijatelji Kirk Johnson i Meron Kekure sutradan dolaze u Paisley Park potražiti Princea. Na svoj užas, nalaze njegovo beživotno tijelo na podu dizala. Prince se nikad nije štedio. Uvijek je davao sve od sebe. Njegov je život bio poput zabave, ali zabave ne traju vječno.

programme.title: Autocesta smrti
programme.desc: Casey Stein (N. Hoult) agrees to steal a cocaine shipment for his former boss (B. Kingsley) so that he could pay a transplant to his girlfriend Juliette (F. Jones). Unfortunately, the drug belongs to Hagen Kahlu (A. Hopkins), the most powerful German king of the drug. Kahl of revenge abducts Juliette and sends his men for Stein. The race begins with a time where Casey desperately tries to save the woman he loves ... / Casey Stein (N. Hoult) pristaje ukrasti pošiljku kokaina za svog bivšeg šefa (B. Kingsley) kako bi mogao platiti transplantaciju svojoj djevojci Juliette (F. Jones). Nažalost, droga pripada Hagenu Kahlu (A. Hopkins), najmoćnijem njemačkom kralju droge. Kahl iz osvete otme Juliette i šalje svoje ljude za Steinom. Počinje utrka s vremenom u kojoj Casey očajnički pokušava spasiti ženu koju voli...

programme.title: Plodovi zemlje
programme.desc: The Sunday show on agriculture and fisheries deals with current topics, critically speaks of agrarian policy, advises and teaches viewers and brings agroprognosis. Najstarija specijalizirana emisija Hrvatske televizije, emitira se od 1958. godine.

programme.title: Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: The guest of the show on Sundays at 2 is Dusko Ilijevic, "Stricek Dusko", a educator at a kindergarten in Zagreb. Based on the 20-year experience of working with children, they will explain why he thinks today's parents are too indulgent and how to set the borders in their daily lives for children. Empathy, climbing the trees, jumping on the mud and using a cell phone are some of the topics of the show that talks about raising children. / Gost emisije Nedjeljom u 2 je Duško Ilijević, "striček Duško", odgajatelj u jednom zagrebačkom dječjem vrtiću. Na temelju 20-godišnjeg iskustva rada s djecom objasnit će zašto misli da su današnji roditelji previše popustljivi i kako djeci postaviti granice u svakodnevnom životu. Empatija, penjanje po drveću, skakanje po blatu i upotreba mobitela neke su od tema emisije u kojoj se govori o odgoju djece.

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: After Mr. Glascott moved into a neighboring house, it is difficult to deal with the Goldbergs with a new social dynamics. Barry was diagnosed with a shameful health condition and asked Geoff and Eric to take care of him. Glascott useli u susjednu kuću, Goldbergovima se teško nositi s novom društvenom dinamikom. Beverly odluči pomoći usamljenome školskom savjetniku da se uklopi u zajednicu s neočekivanim posljedicama. programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam is not in the mood to celebrate Halloween; Barry decides to revive his alter ego, rapper Big Tasty; Barry and Joanne meet Elvir, Mistress of Dark. / Adam nije raspoložen za proslavu Noći vještica; Barry odluči oživjeti svoga alter ega, repera Big Tastyja; Barry i Joanne upoznaju Elviru, Gospodaricu mraka.

programme.desc: Two Eurosong fans seek to help Denise Nurse in finding a new home for themselves and their cat Larry in a beautiful Cumbria. programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: In the granne of Hill in Oxfordshire, Carlos and Maite have ambitious plans for the construction of a dormant home inspired by the Spanish _ country where Maite grew up. But Maite doesn't just want to live in it, but also designs it without having any professional qualifications! It helps her architect, but they have pretty different ideas about what the house should look like. Maite and Carlos put everything on a cube to build their home, but with creative differences and in combination with a limited budget, will Maite manage to achieve their exceptional vision? / U Graven Hillu u Oxfordshireu, Carlos i Maite imaju ambiciozne planove za izgradnju smjelog doma inspiriranog Španjolskom _ zemljom u kojoj je Maite odrasla. Ali Maite ne želi samo živjeti u njemu, već ga i dizajnira, a da pritom nema nikakve profesionalne kvalifikacije! Pomaže joj arhitekt, ali imaju prilično različite ideje o tome kako bi kuća trebala izgledati. Maite i Carlos su sve stavili na kocku kako bi izgradili svoj dom, ali s kreativnim razlikama i u kombinaciji s ograničenim budžetom, hoće li Maite uspjeti ostvariti svoju iznimnu viziju?

programme.desc: He goes to visit chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halach, where he prepares the traditional Cochinita Pibil in the pit. programme.title: Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan shares more practical tips and shows the seasonal stars of her garden. U vrtu Hyde Hall u Essexu Anna Greenland razgledava poznati suhi vrt _ dokaz da i u vrućim i suhim uvjetima možete imati bujan i lijep vrt. Vraća se i stručnjakinja za sobne biljke Claire Lowrie s rješenjima za najčešće nedoumice oko sobnih biljaka.

programme.title: Putovanja za vikend s Greggom Wallaceom
programme.desc: Gregg will spend three days in the German capital. It will be penetrated into the heart of the Berlin gastronomic scene, and will even know the beer culture. Between meals, they will often explore the tumultuous past of that city, and will be indulged in their love, cabaret! / Gregg će provesti tri dana u glavnome gradu Njemačke. Proniknut će u samo srce berlinske gastronomske scene, a upoznat će i pivsku kulturu. Između obroka istraživat će često burnu prošlost toga grada, a prepustit će se i svojoj ljubavi, kabaretu!

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In Trins, an idyllic village of farmers, the Maier family with 500 silver spruce lays the foundation for their own breeding of Christmas trees, a family -owned company to which the originality of Tyrol is inherent. Just ten kilometers south of Trins, Vals Valina begins where Helga, one of the few shepherds in Tyrol, took over the Nockerlalm mountain estate from its grandfather. For several years, her skin grazes. Helga has a mission: explain as many people as possible the connection between the use of mountain pastures, cultural heritage and ensuring the living space as well as the functional mountain landscape. / U Trinsu, idiličnom selu poljodjelaca, obitelj Maier s 500 srebrnih smreka polaže temelj za vlastiti uzgoj božićnih drvca, obiteljsko poduzeće kojemu je svojstvena izvornost Tirola. Samo deset kilometara južno od Trinsa počinje dolina Vals gdje je Helga, jedna od malobrojnih pastirica u Tirolu, preuzela planinsko imanje Nockerlalm od svoga djeda. Već nekoliko godina na njemu pasu njezine koze. Helga ima misiju: objasniti što većem broju ljudi povezanost korištenja planinskih pašnjaka, kulturne baštine i osiguravanja životnog prostora kao i funkcionalnoga gorskog krajolika.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We continue to explore Bregovit Croatia and travel to Moslavina and introduce you to the winemakers there and the pride of their region: scratch. In which ways all ways can be influenced by reducing waste of food in households and restaurants were discussed at a Zero Waste conference. / Nastavljamo istraživati bregovitu Hrvatsku te putujemo u Moslavinu i upoznajemo vas s tamošnjim vinarima i ponosom njihova kraja: škrletom. Upoznajte čovjeka koji u Zagorju uzgaja ljute papričice iz cijeloga svijeta od kojih proizvodi umake pod imenom Volim ljuto. Vodimo vas na ekskluzivno premijerno kušanje Meneghetti vina na njihovo imanje u Istri. Pogledajte što sve predstavlja Hercegovačko selo u Međugorju, kompleks u kojemu se nalazi vinarija i kušaona s najboljim hercegovačkim delicijama. Na koje se sve načine može utjecati na smanjenje otpada od hrane u kućanstvima i restoranima razgovaralo se na konferenciji Zero waste.

programme.title: Eko zona
programme.desc: Work is underway to revitalize the arboretum of brick in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin. After the renovation of the brick castle, built in the Baroque style back in the 2nd half of the 17th century, which decades for decades, a sediment from a small artificial lake was taken out and planned to plant indigenous and rare species. The introductory conference was recently held on the occasion of this project. Jaskovo is a small settlement within the City of Ozalj in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records back in 1433. It is in this ancient region that the economy of the Kovac family is located, which has a high -planned Scottish cattle in open pastures in free cultivation. In addition to cattle, the family grows in an eco -friendly pumpkin, nuts and hazelnuts. We also bring foreign news. A pearl series of islands and islets called the Hell Islands is a protected nature monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. In his bays and straits and today the meadows of Posidonia are still growing. / U tijeku su radovi na revitalizaciji Arboretuma Opeka u općini Vinica pokraj Varaždina. Nakon obnove dvorca Opeka, izgrađenog u baroknom stilu još u 2. polovici 17. stoljeća koji je desetljećima propadao, izvađen je sediment iz malenog umjetnog jezera te se planira sadnja autohtonih i rijetkih vrsta. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. Prvi se put spominje u povijesnim zapisima još davne 1433. kad knez Bartol Frankopan daruje Jaškovljanima paše oko rijeke Dobre na korištenje. Upravo se u tom drevnom kraju smjestilo gospodarstvo obitelji Kovač koja na otvorenim pašnjacima u slobodnom uzgoju ima visokoplaninsko škotsko govedo. Osim goveda na ekološki način obitelj uzgaja i tikve, orahe i lješnjake. Donosimo i strane vijesti. Biserni niz otoka i otočića nazvan Pakleni otoci zaštićeni je spomenik prirode u kategoriji značajnog krajolika još od 1968. godine. U njegovim uvalama i tjesnacima i danas još rastu livade posidonije.

programme.title: Globalna Hrvatska HTV
programme.desc: We explore why numerous settlers, especially descendants of Croats from South America, complain about the system and bureaucracy. We also bring good news for the Croatian Health System _ For the first time, more doctors have returned from abroad than they left. The reasons for this trend speaks to the guest of the show, Vice President of the Croatian Medical Chamber Samija Ropar. Find out how the Baranja doctor has received an opportunity for professional training at the prestigious Mayo Clinic, and what plans for Croatian fruit growers and vegetable growers have, who are also hoping for their products to the Croatian market this year. We were also with representatives of the Croatian Community in Italy and Germany _ in Molise, at the ninth meetings of the Homeland and emigrant Croatia, and in Munich, on the third theater days. We visited the Kaštela School, which was reached by high school students from Argentina, and we also bring stories about influencers who win tiktocs with the content of return and life in Croatia. / Istražujemo zašto se brojni doseljenici, osobito potomci Hrvata iz Južne Amerike, žale na sustav i birokraciju. Donosimo i dobre vijesti za hrvatski zdravstveni sustav _ po prvi put više se liječnika vratilo iz inozemstva nego što ih je otišlo. O razlozima tog trenda govori gošća emisije, potpredsjednica Hrvatske liječničke komore Samija Ropar. Saznajte kako je liječnica iz Baranje dobila priliku za stručno usavršavanje u prestižnoj klinici Mayo, te kakve planove imaju hrvatski voćari i povrtlari iz Bačke, koji se i ove godine nadaju plasmanu svojih proizvoda na hrvatsko tržište. Bili smo i s predstavnicima hrvatske zajednice u Italiji i Njemačkoj _ u Moliseu, na devetim Susretima domovinske i iseljene Hrvatske, te u Munchenu, na trećim Kazališnim danima. Posjetili smo kaštelansku školu u koju su stigli srednjoškolci iz Argentine, a donosimo i priče o influencerima koji osvajaju TikTok sadržajima o povratku i životu u Hrvatskoj.

programme.title: Samo lagano
programme.desc: Today we will be about old _ in a new way. We will also talk about gifted people who have been able to find inspiration in what is daily to create something new and unique. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The Bettany's trip starts in one of the most tallest cities of the subcontinent _ Varanasia. Hindus believes that death in Varanasia and cremation on the banks of the Ganges river allows the cycle of re-birth to interrupt, and salvation achieves. Fatehpur Skri is conceived as an imperial capital of the Mogulski Carkarkar. His new city was bigger than London, but he was inhabited only 14 years. Bettany explores his empty palaces, temples and private pavilions _ at the same time revealing a unique worldview of the man who built them. Bettany goes around the Udaipur Palace. He goes to the boat to the Lake Palace, an extraordinary royal residence located on the island in the shining Lake Pichola. The amazing palace is decorated with massive marble slabs with inserted rubes, onyx, jade and carnella _ that allegedly served as inspiration for decorations within that mahala. The legendary treasure and monument of love, Taj Mahal, was built in 1632. As a tomb for a favorite woman of the Mogulski Emperor Shah Restrained, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany goes out in front of a bright white marble structure to reveal the intriguing secret _ how they are neglected and oversetting the world-famous mausoleum once a haven of love and loss. In the city of Amritsar, the amazing beautiful temple creates an illusion to hover at the center of St. Lake. Gurudwara is the latest pilgrimage place for Sikhe, but the temple is open for pilgrims of all faiths and offers food to each visitors from the largest free kitchen in the world. / Bettanyno putovanje počinje u jednom od najsvetijih gradova potkontinenta _ Varanasiju. Hindusi vjeruju da smrt u Varanasiju i kremiranje na obalama rijeke Ganges omogućuje da se ciklus ponovnog rađanja prekine, a spasenje ostvari. Fatehpur Sikri zamišljen je kao carska prijestolnica mogulskog cara Akbara. Njegov novi grad bio je veći od Londona, no bio je naseljen samo 14 godina. Bettany istražuje njegove prazne palače, hramove i privatne paviljone _ istovremeno otkrivajući jedinstven svjetonazor čovjeka koji ih je izgradio. Bettany obilazi palače Udaipura. Odlazi čamcem do Jezerske palače, izvanredne kraljevske rezidencije smještene na otoku u blistavom jezeru Pichola. Zadivljujuća palača ukrašena je masivnim mramornim pločama s umetnutim rubinima, oniksom, žadom i karneolom _ koji su navodno poslužili kao inspiracija za ukrase unutar Taj Mahala. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany izlazi ispred građevine od blistavo bijelog mramora kako bi otkrila intrigantnu tajnu _ kako su zapušteni i zarasli vrtovi koji okružuju svjetski poznati mauzolej nekoć bili utočišta ljubavi i gubitka. U gradu Amritsar zadivljujuće lijepi hram stvara iluziju da lebdi u središtu svetog jezera. Gurudwara je najsvetije hodočasničko mjesto za Sikhe, no hram je otvoren za hodočasnike svih vjera i nudi hranu svakom posjetitelju iz najveće besplatne kuhinje na svijetu.

programme.title: Inspektor Lynley
programme.desc: When a children's corpse is discovered on the land of a lavish villa in Italy, parents in England seem to have finally found peace from the past. After starting a relationship with her already adult daughter of her friends Julia, she was killed in her apartment in Rome, and Lynley becomes the main suspect for the murder. Njihovo je dijete oteto prije 15 godina i nikad nije nađeno. Lynley, obiteljski prijatelj, koji je tada odigrao sporednu ulogu u istrazi, odlazi u Italiju kako bi bio uz obitelj. Nakon što započne vezu s danas već odraslom kćeri svojih prijatelja Julijom, ona je ubijena u svome stanu u Rimu, a Lynley postaje glavni osumnjičenik za ubojstvo. programme.title: Tihi skitnica
programme.desc: The story of Virgili Skestic, one of the greatest Croatian graphic artist painters. He was born in the village of Kolo near Tomislavgrad. After completing his studies of fine arts in Zagreb, in 1967 he moved to Paris, where he acted until his death in 2009. It is an artist who has declared French art criticism one of the largest graphics of the 20th century. He left behind a great artistic oeuvre and thousands of pages of a personal diary that led to death. His works are exhibited in all relevant world museums _ from France, Japan, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, across the US and Canada. Virgilia Brides made hundreds of oils, drawings, pastel, ceramics and more than 10,000 graphics plates in his life. He is the author of several collections of poetry. He was friends with great literary sizes and Nobel ladies such as Pablo Neruda, Ezra Pound, Samuel Beckett, Andrea de Richaud, Dragutin Tadijanovic, Zlatko Tomicic, Zvonimir Balog, Pierra Seghers. He also worked for them large graphic folders. / Priča o Virgiliju Nevjestiću, jednom od najvećih hrvatskih slikara grafičara. Rođen je u selu Kolo kod Tomislavgrada. Nakon završetka studija likovne umjetnosti u Zagrebu, 1967. seli se u Pariz, gdje djeluje do svoje smrti 2009. godine. Radi se o umjetniku kojeg je francuska likovna kritika proglasila jednim od najvećih grafičara 20. stoljeća. Iza sebe je ostavio veliki umjetnički opus i na tisuće stranica osobnog dnevnika koji je vodio do smrti. Njegova djela su izložena u svim relevantnim svjetskim muzejima _ od Francuske, Japana, Belgije, Velike Britanije, Njemačke, Švicarske, preko SAD-a i Kanade. Virgilije Nevjestić je za života napravio na stotine ulja, crteža, pastela, keramike i više od 10.000 grafičkih ploča. Autor je nekoliko zbirki poezije. Prijateljevao je s velikim književnim veličinama i nobelovcima poput Pabla Nerude, Ezre Pounda, Samuela Becketta, Andrea de Richauda, Dragutina Tadijanovića, Zlatka Tomičića, Zvonimir Baloga, Pierra Seghersa. Za njih je također radio i velike grafičke mape.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: In the first performance art of the season, Dunija, the ethno supergroup, which meet the experience and sensitivities of the exceptional singer -songwriter Dunja Knebl, Nina Romic and Jelena Galic. Their first joint album was now, released last year, at the same time a lively modern realization and project for the preservation of ethnographic heritage. It brings fourteen traditional, mostly sad songs with tunes and texts that originate predominantly from Podravina and Međimurje. Singing about tragic female destinies, in stories of love, abandonment, violence and death, duni give a voice to those who were still silent today. / U prvom izvedbenom Artu sezone gostuju Dunije, etno supergrupa u kojoj se susreću iskustvo i senzibiliteti iznimnih kantautorica Dunje Knebl, Nine Romić i Jelene Galić. Njihov prvi zajednički album Bilo je sada, izdan prošle godine, istovremeno je živo suvremeno ostvarenje i projekt očuvanja etnografske baštine. Donosi četrnaest tradicijskih, mahom tužnih pjesama s melodijama i tekstovima koji potječu pretežito iz Podravine i Međimurja. Pjevajući o tragičnim ženskim sudbinama, u pričama o ljubavi, napuštanju, nasilju i smrti, Dunije daju glas onima koje se nekad i danas utišavalo.

Prabhjotova i Shalinina novogradnja trebala bi biti superbrza montažna kuća koja bi trebala biti izgrađena za nekoliko tjedana, stoga i pomno promišljena te planirana, savršeno dizajnirana za njihove potrebe. programme.desc: Gregg will explore the city that is at their fingertips for three filled days. The Dutch capital is one of the most beautiful cities in Europe. programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: Located between the Inna Valley, the Bavarian Predalp and the picturesque Achene Lake, the Brandenberg Alps in Tyrolean Unterland are rising, where Christoph Muhlegger deals with the traditional mountainous economy. programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The exceptional capital of the Empire of Vijayanagar from the 14th century includes the ruins of the palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonnades, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special carriage streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. / Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. Sveti plesači obilaze sela i hramove, odjeveni u bogate kostime i živopisno obojenih tijela, te utjelovljuju bogove i boginje u glazbenim prizorima koji traju cijelu noć. Bettanyna avantura na Malabarskoj obali završava na jednom od poznatih brodova za stanovanje. Ploveći kanalima ona istražuje drevnu trgovinu začinima koja je oblikovala krajolik i povijest Indije.

Errol Reuben Fernandes odlazi u vrt u središtu Wakefielda koji ide u korak s današnjim vremenom i oko sebe okuplja svoju zajednicu. U Londonu se nalazimo s biljkoholičarem koji je svoje dvorište pretvorio u botanički vrt, a u Devonu upoznajemo glavnog vrtlara koji se na razne načine pokušava nositi s promjenjivom klimom. Osim toga donosimo još videouradaka o vrtovima koje nam šalju gledatelji.

programme.desc: Seeking answers for Ms. Maguire, Sidney found himself in an isolated village without his priestly collar and full of doubts about himself, and only his resourcefulness can save him. programme.desc: The murder of a young Volunteer of Crnkinja, who was killed near her parish, worried the parishioners and other young volunteers who help the poorest in the Pizzofalcone district. A series of discoveries will take investigators in search of his brother a volunteer who was in bad relationships with his sister, and he was seen at the crime scene and since then he has disappeared. Still, some of the disturbing discoveries about the past of the young volunteer will further transfer the suspicion of the pastor. Lojacono seems to be increasingly convinced of the guilt of priests in the investigation that is very sensitive and complicated. / Ubojstvo mlade volonterke crnkinje, koja je ubijena u blizini njezine župe, zabrine župljane i druge mlade volontere koji pomažu najsiromašnijima u četvrti Pizzofalcone. Zabrinutost pojačaju i zle glasine koje dovode u pitanje reputaciju mladog župnika, za kojeg se sumnja da je bio u ljubavnoj vezi sa žrtvom. Niz otkrića odvest će istražitelje u potragu za bratom volonterke koji je bio u lošim odnosima sa sestrom, a viđen je na mjestu zločina i otad je nestao. Ipak, neka od uznemirujućih otkrića o prošlosti mlade volonterke dodatno će prebaciti sumnju na župnika. Čini se da je i Lojacono sve više uvjeren u krivnju svećenika u istrazi je koja je vrlo osjetljiva i komplicirana.

Uz pomoć Državne agencije za borbu protiv organiziranoga kriminala, Nikki i njezina ekipa pokušavaju otkriti istinu. Kako istraga postaje sve potresnija, Nikki se upliće u mafijašku mrežu, s kobnim posljedicama. Dok Jack otkriva šokantne dokaze, Nikki sklapa neočekivani savez i približava se razrješenju slučaja, no po cijenu novih žrtava.

programme.title: Karl Lagerfeld: Razotkrivanje
programme.desc: In 1952, Karl Lagerfeld arrived in Paris, where the fashion industry was in full swing. He met Yves Saint-Laurent and two young men, then assistants in reputable fashion houses, immediately became friends. They had very similar ambitions and even then the rivalry between them was visible. A series of memories scenes takes us to Nazi Germany and Karl's past, which he has been trying to hide all his life. His family supported the Nazis, and Karl was a lonely child, different from classmates. He was very close to his mother, who took him to the first fashion show. Published, he decided to go to Paris and become a designer. / Godine 1952. Karl Lagerfeld stigao je u Pariz, gdje je modna industrija bila u punom zamahu. Upoznao je Yvesa Saint-Laurenta i dva su mladića, tada pomoćnici u uglednim modnim kućama, odmah postali prijatelji. Imali su vrlo slične ambicije i već se tada naziralo suparništvo između njih. Niz scena sjećanja odvodi nas u nacističku Njemačku i Karlovu prošlost, koju je cijelog života pokušavao skriti. Njegova je obitelj podržavala naciste, a Karl je bio usamljeno dijete, različito od prijatelja iz razreda. Bio je vrlo blizak s majkom, koja ga je odvela na prvu modnu reviju. Očaran, odlučio je otići u Pariz i postati dizajner.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Today's tourism has a new guide _ Google Maps. He knows the best path, the most attractive places and locations where it is worth stopping. The spectacular tool for which it actually works _ the whole world. Eight billion people leave reviews that lead us to unforgettable locations, but also to bizarre places we would never discover ourselves. How do digital platforms affect the way we travel and how is our tourist offer adapted to new rules? Croatian tourism of the future _ with one or five stars? / Današnji turizam ima novog vodiča _ Google Maps. On zna najbolji put, najatraktivnija mjesta i lokacije na kojima vrijedi stati. Spektakularan alat za koji zapravo radi _ cijeli svijet. Osam milijardi ljudi ostavlja recenzije koje nas vode do nezaboravnih lokacija, ali i do bizarnih mjesta koja sami nikada ne bismo otkrili. Kako digitalne platforme utječu na način na koji putujemo i kako se novim pravilima prilagodila naša turistička ponuda? Hrvatski turizam budućnosti _ s jednom ili pet zvjezdica?

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: Sometimes the perpetrators of the person you least expect, but Marijo Orlović and his team in his career have seen everything. programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Kristijan Ilicic continues his journey with Egypt, and the traces of the Seljan brothers, as well as a personal fascination with local mythology, lead it to Giza, a town near Kairo, where he visits the world miracle _ pyramid. But the pyramids are just part of the fascinating and enigmatic history of ancient Egypt, which after an all -night train, he continues to explore in Luxor, a city where Pharaoh's ghosts are very present. Christian in Luxor reveals a series of impressive, huge temples with his unusual stories. Drawn to the irresistible charm of the sunset on the Nile, the night welcomed by sailing this great river. Nile was also a peasant brothers a signpost to travel to the final goal of _ Ethiopia. But before going to the depth of Africa, Christian leaves to visit the Red Sea, where he divers around the coral ridge, sailing to the Dolphin house and learns why Hurgada is one of the currently popular tourist destinations. / Kristijan Iličić nastavlja svoje putovanje Egiptom, a tragovi braće Seljan, kao i osobna fascinacija lokalnom mitologijom, vode ga do Gize, grada nedaleko Kaira, gdje posjećuje svjetsko čudo _ piramide. Ali piramide su samo dio fascinantne i zagonetne povijesti Starog Egipta, koju nakon cjelonoćnog putovanja vlakom nastavlja istraživati u Luxoru, gradu u kojem su duhovi faraona itekako prisutni. Kristijan u Luxoru otkriva niz impresivnih, golemih hramova sa svojim neobičnim pričama. Privučen neodoljivim šarmom zalaska Sunca na Nilu, noć dočeka ploveći ovom velikom rijekom. Nil je i braći Seljan bio putokaz za putovanje prema konačnom cilju _ Etiopiji. Ali Kristijan prije odlaska u dubinu Afrike odlazi posjetiti Crveno more, gdje roni oko koraljnog grebena, plovi do Kuće delfina i saznaje zašto je Hurgada jedna od trenutačno popularnijih turističkih destinacija.

programme.desc: The Croatian island of Hvar again becomes the center of the world in the increasingly popular sports discipline _ obstacles. Natjecatelji će se suočiti sa 100 metara brzinskih prepreka, koje testiraju snagu, brzinu i okretnost u izravnom obračunu. HRT će i ove godine pratiti ovo natjecanje u izravnom prijenosu na platformi HRTi te snimci na programu HRT2. Komentator utrke je Bruno Kovačević.

programme.title: Španjolska s Evom Longorijom

This is best visible in San Sebastián, which boasts an extremely rich and original kitchen. / Eva Longoria odlazi u postojbinu svojih predaka kako bi istražila svoje španjolske korijene i otkrila kako su ta prekrasna zemlja i njezina bogata kultura oblikovale jednu od najboljih svjetskih kuhinja. Baskija, kolijevka jedne od najstarijih europskih civilizacija, iako mala i izolirana, nepresušan je izvor maštovitih kulinarskih kreacija. To je najbolje vidljivo u San Sebastiánu, koji se diči iznimno bogatom i originalnom kuhinjom.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: Formerly considered the most dangerous city in the world, Lagos is today the center of contemporary Africa. The driving force of the city is an ubiquitous, almost pathologically positive view of life _ deeply rooted entrepreneurial spirit. The ingenuity of the Nigerian people is at the center of Bourdain's journey as he explores his food, music and rich cultural diversity. Among the dishes are fresh fish delicacies, spicy soups, lots of beef and indispensable crushed jam. Bourdain also spends time with the children of Fele box _ Femi, Seuna and Yeni _ Family who is still in the heart of the creative, political and cultural scene of Lagosa. / Nekada smatran najopasnijim gradom na svijetu, Lagos je danas po mnogočemu središte suvremene Afrike. Pokretačka snaga grada sveprisutni je, gotovo patološki pozitivan pogled na život _ duboko ukorijenjeni poduzetni duh. Domišljatost nigerijskog naroda u središtu je Bourdainova putovanja dok istražuje njegovu hranu, glazbu i bogatu kulturnu raznolikost. Među ponuđenim jelima su svježe riblje delicije, začinjene juhe, mnogo govedine i nezaobilazni zgnječeni jam. Bourdain provodi vrijeme i s djecom Fele Kutija _ Femijem, Seunom i Yeni _ obitelji koja je i dalje u srcu kreativne, političke i kulturne scene Lagosa.

Postoje i druge stvari koje će im barem nakratko odvući misli od vijeća. Tu su natjecanja u postavljanju ograde i miš koji unese pomutnju na farmu. Pravni tim koji je Charlie okupio dolazi u posjet. Iznose svoju strategiju, ali i troškove koji dolaze s tim.

programme.title: All played in Montreux / Svi su svirali u Montreuxu
programme.desc: Starting with music in 1967, practically without any knowledge of the music industry, Claude Nobs turned his dormant hometown on the Lake Geneva Coast into a destination for international music artists. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads ... The list continues, and finally everyone came to Montreux. Claude recorded it all and recorded to the smallest details and created the UNESCO Extraordinary Depth and Quality Archives. From revolutionary performances to stunning and intimate recording of conversations, this film provides an impressive insight into the unique world of Claude Nobs and his love for music. / Počevši se baviti glazbom 1967. godine, praktički bez ikakvog znanja o glazbenoj industriji, Claude Nobs svoj je uspavani rodni grad na obali Ženevskog jezera pretvarao u odredište za međunarodne glazbene umjetnike. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads... popis se nastavlja, i na kraju su svi došli u Montreux. Claude je sve to snimio i zabilježio do najsitnijih detalja i stvorio UNESCO-vu arhivu izvanredne dubine i kvalitete. Od revolucionarnih nastupa do zapanjujućih i intimnih snimaka razgovora, ovaj film pruža impresivan uvid u jedinstveni svijet Claudea Nobsa i njegove ljubavi prema glazbi.

Za trogirsku publiku izveli su najpoznatije operne arije, duete i solo pjesme N. Rimski-Korsakova, P. I. Čajkovskog, C. Gounoda, G. Donizettija, F. Lehara, J. Offenbacha i G. Bizeta. Festival Opera Selecta prometnuo se u jedan od najprestižnijih ljetnih glazbenih događaja na Jadranu, a tvrđava ili kula Kamerlengo ugostila je na desetke vrhunskih izvođača.

Krenuvši od Velikog i Malog Zavižana, Rajinca, preko Hajdučkih i Rožanskih kukova, uzduž Premužićeve staze letimo prema prijelazu Alan i Dundović Mirovu pa do kraja, do Štirovače. Putovat ćemo preko vrhova presvučenih velebitskim brečama, proći Premužićevom stazom, upoznati najljepše cvjetove Velebita, zaviriti u njegov životinjski svijet. Krenuti putem vode u podzemlje. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: As Cuba marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz _ Dizzy Gillespie, who will invite him to play with him, in the mid -1980s. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen _ The one with the consistent Charlie Haden, which will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula. / Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: The HRT Symphony Orchestra opens the new season of the master cycle under the guidance of Maestro Pascal Rophe, who, with this concert, begins his second term of the chief of conductor of the esteemed orchestra. The program begins with the Singing Song of Slava (Chant du Rossignol) Igor Stravinsky, derived from his opera Slavuj (1914). Stravinski's contemporary and countryman Sergei Rahmanjin's second symphony returned his faith in a composer call after a catastrophic failure of the first symphony of 1897 and the severe creative crisis that followed. Another symphony, intended for the large composition of the symphony orchestra, with as many as three instruments each in most width sections and an extended group of percussion, contains an abundance of beautiful, swollen romantic music, but at the same time a masterfully controlled tension that is released in the magnificent final. The concert soloist is one of our most awarded cellist, Monika Leskovar, who, as a thirteen -year -old, became the youngest winner of the International Tchaikovsky Competition in Japan (1995). Rich in international careers, today he teaches at the Academy of Music in Zagreb and always gladly returns to the HRT Symphony Orchestra, and on this occasion in the interpretation of the variation on the Rokoko Theme of Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. Although his role model were classic forms and type of orchestra from Hayn's time, Petar Iljic Tchaikovsky created more than a virtuosic and romantic gorgeous work with a prose rococo theme and complex variations in his variations. / Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a otvara novu sezonu Majstorskog ciklusa pod vodstvom maestra Pascala Rophea koji ovim koncertom počinje svoj drugi mandat šefa dirigenta cijenjenog orkestra. Program počinje simfonijskom pjesmom Pjev slavuja (Chant du rossignol) Igora Stravinskog, proizašlom iz njegove opere Slavuj (1914.). Stravinskijev suvremenik i zemljak Sergej Rahmanjinov Drugom simfonijom vratio je svoju vjeru u skladateljski poziv nakon katastrofalnog neuspjeha Prve simfonije 1897. i teške stvaralačke krize koja je uslijedila. Druga simfonija, namijenjena velikom sastavu simfonijskog orkestra, s čak po tri instrumenta u većini puhačkih sekcija i proširenom skupinom udaraljki, sadrži obilje predivne, nabujale romantičarske glazbe, ali i istovremeno majstorski kontroliranu napetost koja se oslobađa u veličanstvenom finalu. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Bogate međunarodne karijere, danas predaje na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu te se uvijek rado vraća pred Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, a ovom prigodom u interpretaciji Varijacija na rokoko temu Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Iako su mu uzor bile klasične forme i tip orkestra iz Haydnova doba, Petar Iljič Čajkovski u svojim je Varijacijama stvorio više nego virtuozno i romantičarski raskošno djelo s prpošnom rokoko temom i kompleksnim varijacijama.

programme.desc: In the first performance art of the season, Dunija, the ethno supergroup, which meet the experience and sensitivities of the exceptional singer -songwriter Dunja Knebl, Nina Romic and Jelena Galic. Their first joint album was now, released last year, at the same time a lively modern realization and project for the preservation of ethnographic heritage. It brings fourteen traditional, mostly sad songs with tunes and texts that originate predominantly from Podravina and Međimurje. Singing about tragic female destinies, in stories of love, abandonment, violence and death, duni give a voice to those who were still silent today. / U prvom izvedbenom Artu sezone gostuju Dunije, etno supergrupa u kojoj se susreću iskustvo i senzibiliteti iznimnih kantautorica Dunje Knebl, Nine Romić i Jelene Galić. Njihov prvi zajednički album Bilo je sada, izdan prošle godine, istovremeno je živo suvremeno ostvarenje i projekt očuvanja etnografske baštine. Donosi četrnaest tradicijskih, mahom tužnih pjesama s melodijama i tekstovima koji potječu pretežito iz Podravine i Međimurja. Pjevajući o tragičnim ženskim sudbinama, u pričama o ljubavi, napuštanju, nasilju i smrti, Dunije daju glas onima koje se nekad i danas utišavalo.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: As Cuba marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz _ Dizzy Gillespie, who will invite him to play with him, in the mid -1980s. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen _ The one with the consistent Charlie Haden, which will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula. / Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Split Blues Festival

Thus, Croatian Blues performers from Amsterdam, Bologna, London, Paris, as well as from Velika Gorica, Zabok, Sisak, Split, Rogoznica, Lepoglava, Zagreb, Hvar, Solina, Veliki Trgovišće performed: Tony Lee King And Southern Cooking and Charlie and Bell Blues Experience, which are this year's winners of Croatian Blues Challenge and Croatian representatives at the World Blues Competition in Memphis. / U sklopu 11. Split Blues Festivala cjelovečernje koncerte održali su hrvatski blueseri iz domovine i dijaspore. Tako su na istoj pozornici u splitskom Đardinu prodefilirali hrvatski izvođači bluesa iz Amsterdama, Bologne, Londona, Pariza, ali i iz Velike Gorice, Zaboka, Siska, Splita, Rogoznice, Lepoglave, Čiova, Zagreba, Hvara, Solina, Velikog Trgovišća... Nastupili su: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco And Southern Cooking te Charlie And Bell Blues Experience koji su ovogodišnji pobjednici Croatian Blues Challengea i predstavnici Hrvatske na svjetskom blues natjecanju u Memphisu.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In the first episode, we embark on geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian mountain of Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. / U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17.
