programme.title: Camilla - beloved. Wife. Queen. / Camilla - Geliebte. Gemahlin. Konigin.
programme.desc: Once disrespected by the Queen and reviled by the media: Camilla, the wife of King Charles III. - How the beloved became queen. She is now a pillar of the British monarchy and has long since arrived in her new top royal job. "Terra X History" tells the story of her rocky path to the throne. Camilla met the heir to the British throne at a polo match in 1972. The shy Charles was fascinated. But the officer's daughter, who was one year older, was not considered a suitable marriage candidate for the Prince of Wales at the time. Just a year later, Camilla married the British officer Andrew Parker Bowles. Charles walked down the aisle with Lady Diana Spencer in 1981. But despite their marriages, the liaison between Camilla and Charles picked up speed again. When secretly recorded intimate telephone conversations were published in 1992, the relationship was no longer a secret. Camilla's marriage fell apart, followed by Charles and Diana's divorce in 1996. Diana fans blamed Camilla for the breakdown of the marriage. When the "Princess of Hearts" tragically died in a car accident in Paris on August 31, 1997, the British's hatred of Camilla grew even more. She struggled for years to shed the role of Diana's rival and to be publicly accepted as Charles' partner. In the end there was a happy ending for the two of them. When Camilla Parker Bowles and Prince Charles legalized their relationship on April 9, 2005 after more than 30 years, the public had already largely reconciled with them. For Camilla, it was an image change that was second to none. How did she go from being the most hated woman in England to being the royal darling? How was she able to withstand the enormous pressure for years? What is the relationship with Charles and how does she fulfill her new role? / Einst von der Queen missachtet und von den Medien geschmaht: Camilla, die Ehefrau von Konig Charles III. - Wie die Geliebte zur Konigin wurde.Inzwischen ist sie eine Saule der britischen Monarchie und langst angekommen in ihrem neuen royalen Top-Job. "Terra X History" erzahlt ihren steinigen Weg auf den Thron.Bei einem Polospiel traf Camilla 1972 auf den britischen Thronfolger. Der schuchterne Charles war fasziniert. Doch die ein Jahr altere Offizierstochter galt damals nicht als geeignete Heiratskandidatin fur den Prince of Wales.Nur ein Jahr spater ehelichte Camilla den britischen Offizier Andrew Parker Bowles. Charles trat 1981 mit Lady Diana Spencer vor den Traualtar. Doch trotz ihrer Ehen nahm die Liaison zwischen Camilla und Charles wieder Fahrt auf. Als 1992 heimlich mitgeschnittene intime Telefongesprache veroffentlicht wurden, war das Verhaltnis kein Geheimnis mehr. Camillas Ehe ging in die Bruche, 1996 folgte die Scheidung von Charles und Diana. Diana-Fans gaben Camilla die Schuld am Scheitern der Ehe.Als die "Prinzessin der Herzen" bei einem Autounfall in Paris am 31. August 1997 tragisch ums Leben kam, wuchs der Hass der Briten auf Camilla noch. Sie kampfte jahrelang darum, die Rolle der Diana-Rivalin abzulegen und als Lebensgefahrtin von Charles offentlich akzeptiert zu werden. SchlieSSlich gab es fur die beiden doch noch ein Happy End. Als Camilla Parker Bowles und Prinz Charles nach uber 30 Jahren ihr Verhaltnis am 9. April 2005 legalisierten, hatte sich die Öffentlichkeit bereits weitgehend mit ihnen ausgesohnt.Fur Camilla ein Imagewechsel, der seinesgleichen sucht. Wie hat sie es geschafft, von der meistgehassten Frau Englands zum royalen Darling zu werden? Wie hat sie dem enormen Druck jahrelang standhalten konnen? Was macht die Beziehung zu Charles aus, und wie fullt sie ihre neue Rolle aus?

programme.title: Black Box - Dangerous Truth / Black Box - Gefahrliche Wahrheit
programme.desc: After a plane crash in the Alps, the young black box analyst Mathieu quickly discovers the supposed cause of the tragedy. But soon he begins to have doubts as a result of new evidence. Mathieu continues his investigations on his own, penetrating the corrupt abyss of the aviation industry, which is run by careless commercial interests. To reveal the truth, he risks his life and his sanity. As a result of the crash of a passenger plane in the French Alps, only the machine's voice recorder is recovered intact. After the actual head of the investigation, Victor Pollock (Olivier Rabourdin), disappears without a trace, Philippe Renier (Andre Dussollier), head of the French aviation accident investigation agency, entrusts the black box analyst Mathieu Vasseur (Pierre Niney) with the case. The young expert quickly isolates an onboard recording that points to an Islamic terrorist act. The suspicion is made public. However, through the analysis of cell phone data from those around the accident victims, Mathieu begins to have doubts. When he finds out that Pollock was alone with the voice recorder before his disappearance, he breaks into his house. Mathieu finds video recordings of secret meetings between Pollock and the entrepreneur Xavier Renaud (Sebastien Pouderoux), whose company designs computer security systems for aircraft - including for the manufacturer of the accident machine. A pilot reports to Mathieu that the assistance system installed in the crashed plane was considered immature. Mathieu uses the laptop of his wife Noemie (Lou de Laâge), who works at the Aerospace Safety Agency, to obtain sensitive documents about the bumpy testing process of the flight assistance system. In doing so, he is endangering Noemie's job - and his marriage. Using the documents, Mathieu obtains further tests from Renier, which, however, remain inconclusive. He suspects that the voice recorder was replaced. Mathieu is released, but continues to investigate and soon discovers a new lead. When he has the necessary evidence for the true cause of the plane crash in his hands, his life is in danger. The filming of the French paranoia and economic thriller "Black Box - Dangerous Truth" was preceded by extensive research, which was particularly supported by France's real investigative authority Flugunfalle, BEA, who advised director Yann Gozlan and his team on both the script and on set. With a precise image and sound design, the film approaches its aviation milieu and its technical breakdown in detail. The excitement of the cinema hit, which clearly exceeded the million-dollar mark among visitors in France, is in no way inferior to its claim to authenticity. Gozlan wrote the main role of the film specifically for the French actor Pierre Niney. Niney was inspired for his portrayal by, among other things, observing a real black box analyst and Gene Hackman's character from Francis Ford Coppola's genre classic "The Dialogue". / Nach einem Flugzeugabsturz in den Alpen stoSSt der junge Black-Box-Analyst Mathieu schnell auf die vermeintliche Ursache der Tragodie. Doch bald kommen ihm infolge neuer Beweise Zweifel.Mathieu setzt seine Untersuchungen eigenmachtig fort und dringt dabei in die korrupten Abgrunde der von achtlosen Wirtschaftsinteressen geleiteten Luftfahrtindustrie vor. Um die Wahrheit zu enthullen, riskiert er sein Leben und seinen Verstand.Infolge des Absturzes eines Passagierflugzeugs in den franzosischen Alpen wird einzig der Stimmenrekorder der Maschine unversehrt geborgen. Nach dem spurlosen Verschwinden des eigentlichen Ermittlungsleiters, Victor Pollock (Olivier Rabourdin), betraut Philippe Renier (Andre Dussollier), Leiter der franzosischen Untersuchungsbehorde fur Flugunfalle, den Black-Box-Analysten Mathieu Vasseur (Pierre Niney) mit dem Fall. Schnell isoliert der junge Experte eine Bordaufzeichnung, die auf einen islamistischen Terrorakt hindeutet. Der Verdacht wird publik gemacht.Durch die Auswertung von Handydaten aus dem Umfeld der Verungluckten gerat Mathieu jedoch ins Zweifeln. Als er erfahrt, dass Pollock vor seinem Verschwinden allein mit dem Stimmenrekorder zugange war, bricht er in dessen Haus ein. Mathieu findet Videoaufnahmen von Geheimtreffen zwischen Pollock und dem Unternehmer Xavier Renaud (Sebastien Pouderoux), dessen Firma Computersicherheitssysteme fur Flugzeuge entwirft - auch fur den Hersteller der Unglucksmaschine.Ein Pilot berichtet Mathieu, dass das in der abgesturzten Maschine verbaute Assistenzsystem als unausgereift galt. Mathieu beschafft sich uber den Laptop seiner Frau Noemie (Lou de Laâge), die bei der Agentur fur Luft- und Raumfahrtsicherheit arbeitet, sensible Unterlagen zum holprigen Testvorgang des Flugassistenzsystems. Damit gefahrdet er Noemies Job - und seine Ehe.Mit den Dokumenten erwirkt Mathieu bei Renier weitergehende Tests, die allerdings ergebnislos bleiben. Er vermutet, dass der Stimmenrekorder ausgetauscht wurde. Mathieu wird freigestellt, ermittelt jedoch weiter und entdeckt bald eine neue Spur.Als er die notwendigen Beweise fur die wahre Ursache des Flugzeugabsturzes in den Handen halt, gerat er in Lebensgefahr.Dem Dreh des franzosischen Paranoia- und Wirtschaftsthrillers "Black Box - Gefahrliche Wahrheit" ging eine weitreichende Recherche voraus, die in besonderem MaSSe von Frankreichs realer Untersuchungsbehorde fur Flugunfalle, BEA, begleitet wurde, welche Regisseur Yann Gozlan und seinem Team sowohl beim Drehbuch als auch am Set beratend zur Seite stand. Mit einem prazisen Bild- und Sounddesign nahert sich der Film detailgenau seinem Milieu der Luftfahrt und ihrer technischen Aufschlusselung an.Die Spannung des Kinohits, der in Frankreich deutlich die Millionenmarke bei den Besucherinnen und Besuchern knackte, steht seinem Authentizitatsanspruch dabei in nichts nach.Die Hauptrolle des Films schrieb Gozlan dem franzosischen Schauspielstar Pierre Niney auf den Leib. Inspirieren lieSS sich Niney fur seine Darstellung unter anderem durch die Beobachtung eines realen Black-Box-Analysten und durch Gene Hackmans Figur aus Francis Ford Coppolas Genre-Klassiker "Der Dialog".

programme.title: Ein starkes Team
programme.desc: Verena Berthold belongs to a special unit of the Berlin police. She is investigating a drug gang with her new colleague from the East, Otto Garber. However, the two of them don't get along at all in their private lives. Garber, for example, believes that women have no place in the police force. / Verena Berthold gehort zu einer Spezialtruppe der Berliner Polizei. Mit ihrem neuen Ostkollegen Otto Garber ermittelt sie gegen eine Drogenbande.Privat kommen die beiden jedoch gar nicht klar. Garber findet zum Beispiel, dass Frauen bei der Polizei nichts verloren haben.

programme.title: Bares fur Rares - Handlerstucke
programme.desc: Many secrets have already been revealed at "Bares fur Rares" and countless antiques have changed hands in the dealer's room. But the question always arises as to what actually happens to the objects after they are sold. What did the handlers do with it? Now there is the answer to that. In "Bares fur Rares - Handlerpieces" the focus is on the further development of the objects. How is a piece processed, how much effort goes into it, and how much does it cost? And how is the price then restructured? An old, plain cradle is transformed into a colorful eye-catcher, a 4-carat ring is transformed into two new pieces of jewelry, and a pair of old skis are upcycled into an unusual table. / Bei "Bares fur Rares" wurde schon so manches Geheimnis geluftet, und unzahlige Antiquitaten wechselten im Handlerraum den Besitzer.Doch immer wieder kommt die Frage auf, was eigentlich nach dem Verkauf mit den Objekten passiert. Was haben die Handler damit gemacht? Darauf gibt es nun die Antwort. Bei "Bares fur Rares - Handlerstucke" wird der Fokus auf den weiteren Werdegang der Objekte gelegt.Wie wird ein Stuck aufgearbeitet, wie viel Aufwand steckt dahinter, und wie hoch sind die Kosten? Und wie gestaltet sich anschlieSSend der Preis neu?So wird aus einer alten, schmucklosen Kinderwiege ein bunter Eyecatcher, ein 4-Karat-Ring verwandelt sich in zwei neue Schmuckstucke, und ein Paar alte Ski werden zu einem ausgefallenen Tisch upgecycelt.

programme.title: Turken in Deutschland
programme.desc: Around three million people with a Turkish migration background live in Germany - regardless of whether they were born as first-generation migrants or in later generations. The Turkish community is the largest group among people with a migration background in Germany. But: How much Turkey, how much Germany is in the grandchildren and children of the former migrants? How do the Turks live in Germany?"When someone asks me whether I'm a Turk or a Berliner, I always say: I'm a Berliner!" This is how Melih (23), a music-loving baker from the capital, sees himself. His father Ertan runs a large family business for Turkish desserts. "There were only Turks in my class - no other foreigners at all," he says of his childhood. His brother Seyit also works in the company. His homeland is "somewhere in between" - somewhere between Germany and Turkey. Sister Melike (17) is also from Berlin - Turkey is purely a holiday destination for her. "They recognize us straight away - they hate us." She can't really explain why. There are also big differences in appearance. "The hairstyle definitely distinguishes us from the Turks in Turkey - there is hardly any long hair with braids there." Melike has a big dream - she wants to become a singer. To do this, she wanted to record her first song of her own - with the support of her big brother, of course. Selim Demirel fulfilled his dream of owning his own supermarket with his brother-in-law Harun three years ago. The two of them cannot imagine a life in Turkey. "If they said we would give you so much money so you could move to Turkey, I would say no. I would rather stay here." Selim's everyday life begins at six o'clock in the morning at the Cologne GroSSmarkt - here he wants to score the best bargains through clever trading and his Turkish-Kol charm, before he then goes straight on to his small supermarket in the shopping arcade of Bonn's main train station. The family business is open seven days a week - and when things get tight, Selim's sister Hazret steps in. Nebi Sagir (46) was born in Hanover, is a successful businessman on sabbatical and makes no secret of who he voted for in the last Turkish election: Erdogan. “I just found the opposition very weak,” explains the 46-year-old father. His life as a German with Turkish roots wasn't always easy either. "Actually, I always have the feeling that I have to do twice as much as Thomas, Andi or Klaus. Here I was always the Turk and in Turkey I was the German." He finds support and home in the local mosque - religion is important to him. If possible, he tries to pray five times a day. His friend Yacub is also very religious: "A date with Allah is simply wonderful." "I didn't want to be a forever guest," says Abdullah Altun (58) about his journey to Germany. He grew up in Duisburg, attended secondary school and began training at the German Federal Railways in 1983. He graduated with top grades, but was denied a career as a civil servant - because of his Turkish citizenship. "I passed - but I was the wrong person with the wrong passport." An experience that shapes him but does not stop him. In 1996 Altun founded Altun Gleis- und Tiefbau GmbH. Abdullah Altun has not only accepted Germany as his home - he also feels responsible: "I am not a guest. I am part of this house. And sometimes I also repair the foundation." The "ZDF.reportage" delves into German-Turkish worlds on the construction site, in the mosque and in the capital Berlin. One thing is clear to everyone: you are at home in Germany. And yet the question remains: Where is home? In Germany, where you live? Or maybe in Turkey, the country of their ancestors? Or maybe somewhere in between? / Rund drei Millionen Menschen mit turkischem Migrationshintergrund leben in Deutschland - egal, ob als Migranten der ersten Generation oder in spateren Generationen geboren.Die turkische Community ist die groSSte Gruppe unter den Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund in Deutschland. Aber: Wie viel Turkei, wie viel Deutschland steckt in den Enkeln und Kindern der fruheren Migranten? Wie leben die Turken in Deutschland?"Wenn mich jemand fragt, ob ich Turke oder Berliner bin, sag ich immer: Ich bin Berliner!" So sieht sich Melih (23), musikbegeisterter Backer aus der Hauptstadt. Sein Vater Ertan fuhrt ein groSSes Familienunternehmen fur turkische SuSSspeisen. "In meiner Klasse waren nur Turken - gar keine anderen Auslander", erzahlt er aus seiner Kindheit. Auch sein Bruder Seyit arbeitet im Unternehmen. Seine Heimat liegt "irgendwo dazwischen" - irgendwo zwischen Deutschland und der Turkei.Auch Schwester Melike (17) ist Berlinerin - die Turkei ist fur sie ein reines Urlaubsziel. "Die erkennen uns direkt - die hassen uns." Warum, kann sie sich auch nicht wirklich erklaren. Auch beim Aussehen gibt es groSSe Unterschiede. "Die Frisur unterscheidet uns auf jeden Fall von den Turken in der Turkei - lange Haare mit Zopf gibt es dort kaum." Melike hat einen groSSen Traum - sie mochte Sangerin werden. Dafur mochte sie ihren ersten eigenen Song aufnehmen - naturlich mit der Unterstutzung ihres groSSen Bruders.Der Traum vom eigenen Supermarkt - den hat sich Selim Demirel mit seinem Schwager Harun vor drei Jahren erfullt. Ein Leben in der Turkei konnen sich die beiden nicht vorstellen. "Wurden die sagen, wir geben Ihnen so viel Geld, damit konnten Sie in die Turkei umziehen, wurde ich nein sagen. Ich wurde lieber hierbleiben." Selims Alltag beginnt morgens um sechs Uhr auf dem Kolner GroSSmarkt - hier mochte er durch geschicktes Handeln und seinen turkisch-kolschen Charme die besten Schnappchen abraumen, bevor es dann direkt weiter in seinen kleinen Supermarkt in der Einkaufspassage des Bonner Hauptbahnhofs geht. Sieben Tage die Woche hat der Familienbetrieb geoffnet - und wenn es mal eng wird, springt Selims Schwester Hazret ein.Nebi Sagir (46) ist in Hannover geboren, erfolgreicher Geschaftsmann im Sabbatjahr und macht keinen Hehl daraus, wen er bei der letzten Turkeiwahl gewahlt hatte: Erdogan. "Ich fand die Opposition einfach sehr schwach", erklart der 46-jahrige Familienvater. Auch sein Leben als Deutscher mit turkischen Wurzeln war nicht immer einfach. "Eigentlich habe ich immer das Gefuhl, das Doppelte leisten zu mussen wie Thomas, Andi oder Klaus. Hier bin ich immer der Turke gewesen und in der Turkei war ich der Deutschlander." Halt und Heimat findet er in der ortlichen Moschee - Religion ist fur ihn wichtig. Wenn moglich, versucht er funf Mal am Tag zu beten. Auch sein Freund Yacub ist sehr religios: "Eine Verabredung mit Allah ist einfach wunderschon.""Ich wollte kein ewiger Gast sein", sagt Abdullah Altun (58) uber seinen Weg nach Deutschland. Er wachst in Duisburg auf, besucht die Hauptschule und beginnt 1983 eine Ausbildung bei der Deutschen Bundesbahn. Er schlieSSt mit Bestnoten ab, doch die Beamtenlaufbahn bleibt ihm verwehrt - wegen seiner turkischen Staatsburgerschaft. "Ich habe bestanden - aber ich war der Falsche mit dem falschen Pass." Eine Erfahrung, die ihn pragt, aber nicht aufhalt. 1996 grundet Altun die Altun Gleis- und Tiefbau GmbH. Abdullah Altun hat Deutschland nicht nur als Heimat angenommen - er fuhlt sich auch verantwortlich: "Ich bin kein Gast. Ich bin Teil dieses Hauses. Und manchmal repariere ich auch das Fundament."Die "ZDF.reportage" taucht ein in deutsch-turkische Welten auf der Baustelle, in der Moschee und in der Hauptstadt Berlin. Eines ist fur alle klar: Sie sind in Deutschland zu Hause. Und doch bleibt die Frage: Wo ist die Heimat? In Deutschland, wo sie leben? Oder doch in der Turkei, dem Land ihrer Vorfahren? Oder vielleicht irgendwo dazwischen?

Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. programme.title: Good Morning Portugal Weekend / Bom Dia Portugal Fim de Semana
programme.desc: A space where current national and international news, sports, weather, traffic and economics are highlighted during your weekend mornings. / Espaço em que se dá relevo às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia nas manhas do seu fim de semana.

programme.title: Contagem Decrescente para Caçar
programme.desc: From leopards and wolves to sharks and snakes, witness the brutal power and tenacity of nature's most extraordinary predators on a journey through Australia, Africa, North America and South America. / De leopardos e lobos a tubarões e cobras, testemunhe o poder brutal e a tenacidade dos predadores mais extraordinários da natureza numa jornada pela Austrália, África, America do Norte e America do Sul.

programme.title: Hora dos Portugueses
programme.desc: Daily magazine, with different perspectives, with Portuguese communities spread around the world, to portray the current ways of experiencing Portugueseness in different territories and recognize the achievements and achievements of the Portuguese who make up these groups of citizens. / Magazine diário, com diferentes olhares, junto de comunidades de portugueses espalhados pelo mundo, para retratar as atuais formas de viver a portugalidade nos diferentes territorios e reconhecer os feitos e conquistas dos portugueses que compõem estes grupos de cidadaos.

programme.title: Here Portugal - The Best Moments / Aqui Portugal - Os Melhores Momentos
programme.desc: Remember the best moments of the program that covers and warms hearts from north to south of the country, showcasing the best that Portugal has to offer. A journey to discover culture, gastronomy and local traditions, always with lots of music to entertain you. / Recorde os melhores momentos do programa que percorre e aquece os corações de norte a sul do país, dando a conhecer o que de melhor Portugal tem para oferecer. Uma viagem à descoberta da cultura, da gastronomia e das tradições locais, sempre com muita música a animar.

programme.title: Portugal Fenomenal
programme.desc: We know a palace with a fearsome curse. We visit a convent where it is possible to see and feel how its friars lived 400 years ago. We continue to Gondomar, where a mine abandoned 50 years ago is still very present in the daily lives of the population. And finally, we reveal a sanctuary. / Conhecemos um palácio com uma temível maldiçao. Visitamos um convento onde e possível ver e sentir como viviam os seus frades há 400 anos. Seguimos ate Gondomar, onde uma mina abandona há 50 anos continua bem presente no quotidiano da populaçao. E por fim, revelamos um santuário.

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Every day, at 1pm, your lunch hour is completed with updates on national and global news, from politics, economics, society and not forgetting sport. With Jornal da Tarde, be well informed about what is happening in the country and the world! / Todos os dias, às 13h, a sua hora de almoço e completada com a atualizaçao das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto. Com o Jornal da Tarde, esteja bem informado sobre o que acontece no país e no mundo!

programme.title: Voz do Cidadao
programme.desc: Program under the responsibility of the Viewer's Ombudsman, being shown regularly across all channels of the Public Television Service, reflects the treatment of the most significant cases brought to the attention of the Provider by viewers each week. / Programa da responsabilidade do Provedor do Telespectador, sendo exibido regularmente atraves de todos os canais do Serviço Público de Televisao, reflete o tratamento dos casos mais significativos trazidos à apreciaçao do Provedor pelos telespetadores em cada semana.

programme.title: Stars on Saturday / Estrelas ao Sábado
programme.desc: In Estrelas ao Sábado, the talent and roots of our music will shine. Isabel Silva is the host of this innovative format, which will give a voice to all those who want to show their talent, interpreting the most diverse genres of Portuguese popular music, but only one will be the winner. / Em Estrelas ao Sábado vao brilhar o talento e as raízes da nossa música. Isabel Silva e a anfitria deste formato inovador, que vai dar voz a todos aqueles que queiram mostrar o seu talento, interpretando os mais diversos generos da música popular portuguesa, mas so um será o vencedor.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: The most rigorous selection of news, every day at 8 pm. From Monday to Sunday, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos and Ana Lourenço show you the most relevant events in the country and around the world. If it's important, it's on Telejornal. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se e importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: World Qualification 2026 - Portugal x Republic of Ireland (Live) / Qualificaçao Mundial 2026 - Portugal x República da Irlanda (Direto)
programme.desc: Portugal faces Ireland, at the Jose Alvalade Stadium, in a game counting towards qualification for the 2026 World Cup. Portugal is part of group F, which also includes Armenia, Hungary and the Republic of Ireland. / Portugal enfrenta a Irlanda, no Estádio Jose Alvalade, num jogo a contar para a qualificaçao para o Campeonato do Mundo 2026. Portugal faz parte do grupo F do qual fazem parte tambem a Armenia, a Hungria e a República da Irlanda.

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Gabriela Barros, Cândido Costa, Rui Melo and Madalena Almeida accepted the challenge and will face the most unimaginable tests in Taskmaster. With Vasco Palmeirim and Nuno Markl at the helm. / Gabriela Barros, Cândido Costa, Rui Melo e Madalena Almeida aceitaram o desafio e vao enfrentar as provas mais inimagináveis em Taskmaster. Com Vasco Palmeirim e Nuno Markl ao comando.

programme.title: 5 To Midnight / 5 Para a Meia-Noite
programme.desc: The program is inspired by the tradition of late night shows, with interviews, challenges and lots of humor, thanks to the creativity of its 5 presenters. / O programa inspira-se na tradiçao dos late night shows, com entrevistas, desafio e muito humor, graças à criatividade dos seus 5 apresentadores.

programme.title: Janela Indiscreta
programme.desc: Rear Window and its cinema program! It presents, first-hand, cinematographic premieres and exclusive interviews with the protagonists of national and international productions, revealing curiosities and behind-the-scenes stories. / O Janela Indiscreta e o seu programa de cinema! Apresenta, em primeira mao, estreias cinematográficas e entrevistas exclusivas aos protagonistas das produções nacionais e internacionais, dando a conhecer curiosidades e historias de bastidores.

programme.title: The Golden Eagle - The Appeal of Nature / A Águia-Real - O Apelo da Natureza
programme.desc: In this two-part documentary we follow the life of an eagle. Over the course of an entire year, we follow the young bird on an odyssey, from parental care to independence and its challenging search for its own territory. / Neste documentário de duas partes acompanhamos a vida de uma águia. Ao longo de um ano inteiro, acompanhamos o jovem pássaro numa odisseia, desde o cuidado parental ate a independencia e a sua desafiadora procura por um territorio proprio.

programme.title: To Peninsula / A Península
programme.desc: The mountains define the morphology of the Iberian Peninsula and are the cradle of the rivers that distribute life throughout the territory. The mountains are also the location of several forests, each with its own distinct ecosystem. The Iberian mountain ranges have different facets and their own personalities. / As montanhas definem a morfologia da Península Iberica e sao o berço dos rios que distribuem a vida pelo territorio. As montanhas sao tambem o local de várias florestas, cada uma com o seu ecossistema distinto. As cadeias montanhosas ibericas tem facetas diferentes e personalidades proprias.

programme.title: Fauna Iberica
programme.desc: Climate change is a reality and is seriously affecting the environment. Fauna is subject to a series of changes that can sometimes be overcome by habitat changes. Migrating to colder areas or changing your activity rhythms. / A mudança climática e uma realidade e está a afetar seriamente o meio ambiente. A fauna está sujeita a uma serie de mudanças que às vezes podem ser superadas pela mudança de habitat. Migrando para áreas mais frias ou mudando seus ritmos de atividade.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Lost Temple / Indiana Jones e o Templo Perdido
programme.desc: Accompanied by the singer “Willie” and little Short Round, Indiana Jones tries to recover a sacred stone and save hundreds of children who are enslaved by a violent and mysterious cult in India. / Acompanhado pela cantora “Willie” e pelo pequeno Short Round, Indiana Jones tenta recuperar uma pedra sagrada e salvar centenas de crianças que se encontram escravizadas por um violento e misterioso culto na Índia.

programme.title: Domingo Há Desgarrada
programme.desc: "Domingo Há Desgarrada" will highlight the songs: whether Minhotos, Alentejanos or Beirões and also prove that Cantares ao Desafio are present around the world. We will have mentors who bring pairs to compete and we will choose the best singers from afar. / "Domingo Há Desgarrada" vai dar destaque aos cantares: quer seja Minhotos, Alentejanos ou Beirões e ainda provar que os Cantares ao Desafio estao presentes pelo mundo. programme.desc: In the program "A Minha Cena" children are the protagonists. Every week, in each episode, the children take us through their lives and show us their "favorite scenes". / No programa "A Minha Cena" as crianças sao as protagonistas. Todas as semanas, em cada episodio, as crianças conduzem-nos pela sua vida e mostram-nos as suas "cenas favoritas".

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito

Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos

programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Ecos da Historia
programme.sub-title: Greece: The Twilight of a Monarchy / Grecia: O Crepúsculo de uma Monarquia
programme.desc: In the early 1960s, with the collapse of colonial empires all over the world, Salazar's Portugal fought a bloody war in its African territories. Isolated on the international scene, the oldest dictatorship in Europe and the image of a backward country. / No início dos anos 60 com o colapso dos imperios coloniais um pouco por todo o mundo, Portugal de Salazar trava uma guerra sangrenta nos seus territorios africanos. Isolada na cena internacional, a mais antiga ditadura da Europa e a imagem de um país atrasado..

programme.title: Women's Roller Hockey Super Cup - Benfica x AD Sanjoanense (Live) / Supertaça Feminina de Hoquei em Patins - Benfica x AD Sanjoanense (Direto)
programme.desc: The Pavilhao Multiusos de Odivelas will be the stage for the Women's Super Cup final with Benfica, holder of the championship and the Cup, facing AD Sanjoanense, the losing finalist of the Portuguese Cup. / O Pavilhao Multiusos de Odivelas vai ser o palco da final da Supertaça Feminina com o Benfica, detentor do campeonato e da Taça, a enfrentar a AD Sanjoanense, finalista vencida da Taça de Portugal.

programme.title: Afazeres do Mes
programme.desc: Monthly magazine about work in the vegetable garden and garden. programme.title: Come Rain Come Sunshine / Faça Chuva Faça Sol
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s Portugal was self-sufficient in hop production, today it only produces around 5% of its needs. Discover this raw material that is responsible for the bitter taste of traditional beer. The hop flower grows in the lands of Bragança and Braga. / Na decada de 1960 e 1970 Portugal era autossuficiente na produçao de lúpulo, hoje produz apenas cerca de 5% das suas necessidades. Conheça esta materia-prima que e responsável pelo travo amargo da cerveja tradicional. A flor de lúpulo cresce nas terras de Bragança e Braga.

programme.title: Room Sheet / Folha de Sala
programme.desc: A cultural agenda that highlights theater, music and other shows, not forgetting the launch of books and records, cinema and other events, such as exhibitions, open-air shows and conferences. Text and voiceover by Manuela Silva Reis. / Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, nao esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realizaçao de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferencias. programme.title: Health Issues / Questões de Saúde
programme.sub-title: Breast Cancer Diagnosis - New Therapies, Better Hypotheses for a Cure / Diagnostico de Cancro da Mama - Novas Terapias, Melhores Hipoteses de Cura
programme.desc: Neste episodio sao analisadas as mais recentes terapias personalizadas contra o cancro da mama, desde tratamentos dirigidos a terapias inovadoras que oferecem cuidados adaptados ao perfil genetico de cada paciente.

programme.title: Newspaper 2 / Jornal 2
programme.desc: The world in 30 minutes. In Jornal 2 we analyze facts and cross-reference opinions. With each passing day we read the country and the world with data, explanations and interpretations in the most diverse areas, such as Politics, Science, Economy and Culture. / O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciencia, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: RP 80 - Castro
programme.desc: In Ricardo Pais' production, Castro is a political and rhetorical tragedy where Ines de Castro confronts regional power with an ethics of speech. The scenography, music and bodies of the actors amplify the conflict between reason of state and passion. In Porto, at the Teatro Nacional Sao Joao. / Na encenaçao de Ricardo Pais, Castro e uma tragedia política e retorica onde Ines de Castro confronta o poder regio com uma etica da palavra. A cenografia, música e corpo dos atores amplificam o conflito entre razao de Estado e paixao. No Porto, no Teatro Nacional Sao Joao.

programme.title: Room Sheet / Folha de Sala
programme.desc: A cultural agenda that highlights theater, music and other shows, not forgetting the launch of books and records, cinema and other events, such as exhibitions, open-air shows and conferences. programme.title: The Sword and the Rose / A Espada e a Rosa
programme.desc: Manuel says goodbye to the routines of his Lisbon life and embarks on a 16th century Portuguese caravel. XV governed by the laws of piracy. A betrayal on board triggers a series of terrible events that the protagonist goes through without compromising his moral principles. / Manuel despede-se das rotinas da sua vida lisboeta e embarca numa caravela portuguesa do sec. XV governada pelas leis da pirataria. Uma traiçao a bordo desencadeia uma serie de acontecimentos terríveis que o protagonista atravessa sem beliscar os seus princípios morais.

programme.title: Filhas do Fogo
programme.desc: Basque Country, 1609. After judge Pierre de Lancre burns a wise woman on suspicion of witchcraft, her three daughters are threatened with suspicion, misogyny and religious fanaticism. / País Basco, 1609. Depois do juiz Pierre de Lancre queimar uma mulher sábia por suspeita de bruxaria, as suas tres filhas sao ameaçadas com suspeitas, misoginia e fanatismo religioso.

programme.title: Sergio Varella Cid - A Prodigy on a Razor's Edge / Sergio Varella Cid - Um Prodígio no Fio da Navalha
programme.desc: Sergio Varella Cid, a piano prodigy since he was 3 years old, was compared to Mozart. At 15, he moved to London, facing challenges and opportunities. With talent and a taste for risk, he became one of the greatest international pianists. / Sergio Varella Cid, prodígio do piano desde os 3 anos, foi comparado a Mozart. Aos 15, mudou-se para Londres, enfrentando desafios e oportunidades. Com talento e gosto pelo risco, tornou-se um dos maiores pianistas internacionais.

programme.title: Sacavem
programme.desc: It is not the routine documentary about an artist, in this case the filmmaker Pedro Costa, nor is it a balanced view of his work. Among other merits, "Sacavem" dialogues with this greatest figure in contemporary cinema without resorting to the usual guarantees. / Nao e o rotineiro documentário sobre um artista, neste caso o cineasta Pedro Costa, nem tao pouco uma visao equilibrada da sua obra. Entre outros meritos, "Sacavem" dialoga com essa figura maior do cinema contemporâneo sem recorrer às habituais cauções.

programme.title: Outra Goa
programme.desc: The social atmosphere is captured, in interviews with the generations that lived through Portuguese colonialism and the transition to the Indian nation and those that live in post-colonial Goa, whose rhythms we will follow and whose forms of sociability we will record. / A atmosfera social e captada, em entrevistas com as gerações que viveram o colonialismo portugues e a transiçao para a naçao indiana e as que vivem a Goa pos-colonial, cujos ritmos acompanharemos e cujas formas de sociabilidade registaremos.

programme.title: ABC Direito
programme.desc: Public service program, which functions as a manual on the laws of life. Through an original, artistic and informative format, each episode aims to inform citizens about their rights and responsibilities under Portuguese law. / Programa de serviço público, que funciona como um manual de leis da vida. Atraves de um formato original, artístico e informativo, cada episodio tem como objetivo informar os cidadaos sobre os seus direitos e responsabilidades ao abrigo da lei portuguesa.

programme.desc: This episode asks different people of African descent, of different ages, from different cultural backgrounds and of both genders, what the role of African descent means and how they live it. / Este episodio indaga junto de diferentes afrodescendentes, de diferentes idades, de diferentes meios culturais e de ambos generos, o que significa e como vivem na pele o papel de afrodescendente.

programme.desc: The most incredible forests and jungles in the world in a 26-episode documentary series. Uma viagem à volta do mundo à descoberta da abundante biodiversidade que as últimas grandes florestas e selvas do planeta albergam: desde os habitantes mais estranhos ate às regiões mais belas e inexploradas.

programme.desc: "Facce dAmore" is the second solo album by Polish countertenor Jakub Jozef Orlinski. All the songs tell a story, which illustrates the male figure of the Baroque period, not only the positive aspect such as the pleasure of mutual love, but also anger and even madness. / "Facce dAmore" e o segundo álbum a solo do contratenor polaco Jakub Jozef Orlinski. Todas as canções contam uma historia, que ilustra a figura masculina da epoca barroca, nao apenas o aspeto positivo como o prazer do amor mútuo, mas tambem a raiva e ate a loucura.

programme.title: Capitalismo Americano: O Culto da Riqueza
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, a club of millionaires - John D. Rockefeller and his oil monopoly, the steel king and philanthropist Andrew Carnegie or the banker J. P. Morgan who, from Wall Street, financed the industrial revolution - emerged from America. / No final do seculo XIX, um clube de milionários - John D. Rockefeller e o seu monopolio petrolífero, o rei do aço e filantropo Andrew Carnegie ou o banqueiro J. P. Morgan que, a partir de Wall Street, financiou a revoluçao industrial - emergiu da America.

programme.title: Cinemax

programme.title: Insolaçao Mortal
programme.desc: Ted and Amanda's intense work finally shows results and Jong Min's remains are found in the river. programme.title: Sergio Varella Cid - A Prodigy on a Razor's Edge / Sergio Varella Cid - Um Prodígio no Fio da Navalha
programme.desc: Sergio Varella Cid, a piano prodigy since he was 3 years old, was compared to Mozart. At 15, he moved to London, facing challenges and opportunities. Aos 15, mudou-se para Londres, enfrentando desafios e oportunidades. Com talento e gosto pelo risco, tornou-se um dos maiores pianistas internacionais.

programme.title: Outra Goa
programme.desc: The social atmosphere is captured, in interviews with the generations that lived through Portuguese colonialism and the transition to the Indian nation and those that live in post-colonial Goa, whose rhythms we will follow and whose forms of sociability we will record. / A atmosfera social e captada, em entrevistas com as gerações que viveram o colonialismo portugues e a transiçao para a naçao indiana e as que vivem a Goa pos-colonial, cujos ritmos acompanharemos e cujas formas de sociabilidade registaremos.

programme.title: Arsenal vs West Ham United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Arsenal have lost both of their last two home league games against West Ham, only ever losing three in a row once before. West Ham United are looking to become only the second side to win three successive Premier League away games against Arsenal, after Manchester City, who won six on the bounce from March 2018 to February 2023.

programme.title: Brentford vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Since completing a Premier League double over Manchester City in 2022-23, Brentford are winless in their last four against the Citizens in the division. Manchester City have only lost one of their four Premier League visits to Brentford, going down 1-0 on the final day of the 2022-23 season.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool -English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: After their 3-1 win in May, Chelsea could enjoy back-to-back league wins over Liverpool for the first time since November 2014. Liverpool are winless in their last four Premier League games at Stamford Bridge and could lose away to Chelsea two seasons running in the league for the first time since losing three on the bounce from 2004-05 to 2006-07.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Sunderland - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just two of their last 30 league games against Sunderland, with this their first since a 3-0 win in April 2017. Across all competitions, Sunderland have managed to win just one of their last 31 away games against Manchester United, winning 1-0 in May 2014 thanks to Sebastian Larsson’s winner.

programme.desc: Chengdu Rongcheng will face Gangwon for the first time in AFC Champions League Elite; each of the last three games in the competition between teams from Korea and China have been won by the former by an exact 2-1 score, including Gangwon’s win over Shanghai Shenhua in the first round of the 2025-26 season. Gangwon beat Shanghai Shenhua 2-1 in their first ever AFC Champions League Elite game at home; the last Korean side to suffer at least one defeat in their first two games in the competition is Jeju United in 2011, while no side from Korea has suffered defeat in their first away game in the AFC Champions League Elite.

programme.title: My Faith in Sport
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab.Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 317 / MMA UFC 317
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: New York Giants - Philadelphia Eagles / Američki fudbal - NFL: New York Giants - Philadelphia Eagles
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Milano - Monaco / Košarka - Euroleague: Milano - Monaco
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Split - Partizan / Košarka - ABA liga: Split - Partizan
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Besiktas - Onvo / Košarka - Turska liga: Besiktas - Onvo
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Spartak - Vienna / Košarka - ABA liga: Spartak - Vienna
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. The most won titles are counted by the Kil Handball Club. programme.title: Football - English League: Brentford - Manchester City / Fudbal - Engleska liga: Brentford - Manchester City
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. programme.title: Football - Scotland League: Falkirk - Rangers / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Falkirk - Rangers
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. Two teams then divided the champion title because of the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today the world-famous Glazegov Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles and today a relatively unknown club Dumbarton. The League itself has changed the names and format in a couple of occasions, but since 2013. it is officially called Scottish Professional Football League and is the highest rank of Scottish football. League also marks one of the largest derbies in the history of football between the two Glasgovske teams of Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. To su bili danas svetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata menjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove Scottish Professional Football League i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obeležava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian League: Varese - Milano / Košarka - Italijanska liga: Varese - Milano
programme.desc: The long history of Italian lega Basket Serie and dates back to the back of 1920. And her insight. The first winner was the basuary of the basket of the same 1920. years. This league has great importance for European club basketball as league who gave over 35 titles of her clubs in European competitions starting from the Euroleague, FIBA ​​Saport Cup and Radivoje Korać Cup. Only the competition consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents two-circle, followed by a plejof of eight teams. Eliminating matches are played on four seven or England-based matches Best of Seven. / Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske Lega Basket Serie A datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija Best of seven.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Bayern - Zalgiris / Košarka - Euroleague: Bayern - Zalgiris
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Sportske igre mladih
programme.desc: Youth sports games are the largest manifestation for children and youth in this area, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Fenerbahce - Petkim Pass / Košarka - Turska liga: Fenerbahce - Petkim Spor
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Germany League: Bonn - Oldenburg / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Bonn - Oldenburg
programme.desc: The history of the German club basketball dates back to 1939. years, but the German basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964. while only the competition sets two years later. The competition consists of 18 teams, and the season is divided into the regular part where everyone plays with each two-circuit and the Plejof section that steps after completing the regular part. The last two of the regular part of the regular part drop out in the lower rank, while the Plejofor gets the Best of Five format where the teams must receive minimum 3 matches from 5 to eject the rivals. The interestingness of the league is that each team must have a hall of a minimum of 3000 places for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Poslednje dve ekipe regularnog dela ispadaju u niži rang, dok se u plejofu pobednik dobija Best of five formatu gdje ekipe moraju dobiti minmalno 3 utakmice od 5 kako bi izbacili rivala. Zanimljivost lige je da svaka ekipa mora imati dvoranu od minimalno 3000 mesta za publiku.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Future - Trento / Košarka - Eurocup: Budućnost - Trento
programme.desc: EUROPUP CASTED 2002. years as a second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to elect placement in the Euroleague are struggling in this competition, and in it, they participate mainly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues. The placement in Eurocup is ensured through national championships and cups, and through the invitations of the so-called Wildkards. / Evrokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo takmičenje Evroleague Basketball. U ovom takmičenju se bore najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspeju izboriti plasman u Evroligu, te u njemu sudeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih evropskih liga. Plasman u Evrokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. vajldkards.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Paris - Virtus Bologna / Košarka - Euroleague: Paris - Virtus Bologna
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. On that day in New York, the most elite world basketball competition, the NBA league was founded. 29 Teams from the US and one from Canada Each autumn begins the hunt for the legendary ring intended for the Champions of the NBA league. The teams are divided into an east and western conference and through 82 regular season, the regular season hunting one of the eight playoff positions. Conference champions are entering the large NBA final where in a series of a maximum of seven games decide on the new champion. The NBA final is one of the most accurate sports events of the year that delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna meseca davne 1946. godine zauvek će promeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Vienna - Illyria / Košarka - ABA liga: Vienna - Ilirija
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin League: Future - Lake / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Budućnost - Jezero
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Fighter - worker / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Radnik
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found its happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different branches of sports, and they could have been convinced here how true the famous Serbian hospitality stories are true. Some of them found the love of your life here, found homes, friends for all life, get citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what their life is, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. Kakav je njihov odnos prema Srbiji i kakav je njihov život, saznajte u našoj emisiji.

Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Rudar - Borac / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Rudar - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Charles moves to Kansas with his wife and daughters. The lush Indian landscape already likes him. They quickly settle with their wife and three daughters. programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.
