Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Hokej (M): Olimpija - Black Wings, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026
programme.desc: The League under different names has existed since its founding in 1923, with a break during World War II. Until 2005, only Austrian teams performed, and then, over the years, Slovenian, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Italian, Hungary and Slovakia joined. There are 14 teams in the league, and Slovenian colors are represented by HK Olimpija Ljubljana. / Liga pod različnimi imeni obstaja od svoje ustanovitve leta 1923, s prekinitvijo v času druge svetovne vojne. V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Football (M): Kosovo - Slovenia, World Cup qualifiers 2025 / Nogomet (M): Kosovo - Slovenija, Kvalifikacije za Svetovno prvenstvo 2025
programme.desc: Matjaž Kek's guards are waiting for a hosting hosting in Kosovo on Friday. Slovenians will come to the first victory in Group B? More than two hundred members of the International Football Organization (FIFA) competes in the qualifiers for the main World Cup tournament. Dolage and very tense qualifications vary depending on which continental confederation is. However, it is common for everyone to be an overture to the final tournament. The qualification is further enhanced by the fact that no one but the host has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions have to compete for the opportunity to defend the title. / Varovance Matjaža Keka v petek čaka gostovanje na Kosovu. Bodo Slovenci prišli do prve zmage v skupini B?Več kot dvesto članic Mednarodne nogometne organizacije (FIFA) tekmuje v kvalifikacijah za glavni turnir svetovnega prvenstva v nogometu.Dolge in zelo napete kvalifikacije se razlikujejo glede na to, za katero kontinentalno konfederacijo gre. Vsem pa je skupno to, da gre za uverturo v končni turnir.Pomen kvalifikacij še povečuje dejstvo, da na zaključnem turnirju nima pravice sodelovati nihče razen gostitelja, svetovni prvaki pa se morajo izboriti za priložnost za obrambo naslova.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. programme.title: To nicer: Old Believers, Mon. / Na lepše: Staroverci, pon.
programme.desc: The team of the show to nicer this time walked along the paths of the old faith, which helps us understand the life and spirituality of our ancestors. They visited the Vogrsko mansion, where the rarely seen objects of Starišci were on display, gathered by the granddaughter of Paul Medvešček, a well -known researcher and writer of folk tradition. The path of the old religion continues in the Doblarec Gorge, the strongest right tributary of the Soča River, where the former shrine was. In Kambrešek, who borders with the adjacent Venice, she spoke about Jožica Strgar about the habits of her ancestors along the wooden hearth in a monumentally protected Lukec House. In the show, the story of the unusual rituals performed in the Triglavac Cave, where Boris Čok, researcher of the old faith, took the team. / Ekipa oddaje Na lepše je tokrat hodila po poteh stare vere, ki nam pomaga razumeti življenje in duhovnost naših prednikov. Obiskali so dvorec Vogrsko, kjer so bili na ogled postavljeni redko videni predmeti starovercev, katere je zbrala vnukinja Pavla Medveščka, znanega raziskovalca in zapisovalca ljudskega izročila. Pot stare vere se nadaljuje v soteski Doblarec, najmočnejšem desnem pritoku reke Soče, kjer je bilo nekdanje svetišče. Na Kambreškem, ki meji s sosednjo Benečijo pa je o navadah svojih prednikov ob lesenem ognjišču v spomeniško zaščiteni Lukčevi hiši, spregovorila Jožica Strgar. V oddaji pa tudi zgodba o nenavadnih ritualih, ki so jih njega dni izvajali v jami Triglavca, kamor je ekipo odpeljal Boris Čok, raziskovalec stare vere.

programme.title: FREE SPIRITS - Samosko: Bilal, Jasmina, Akash, Documentary Series, Mon. / Free spirits - Samosvoji: Bilal, Jasmina, Akash, dokumentarna serija, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Arnob Chakrabarty, Patrick Bisschops, Sabuj Miah, Stamcar Matic ... The personal story of a man who raises his views and actions dust in his surroundings. / R: Arnob Chakrabarty, Patrick Bisschops, Sabuj Miah, Štamcar Matic... Osebna zgodba človeka, ki svojimi stališči in dejanji dviga prah v svoji okolici.
programme.desc: The Dutch word "Stoer" means stubborn and is an artistic installation of Amsterdam's visual artist B a B a Chahal, which points to gender and sexuality and all related to it. The pink color of the robust letters raises questions: what does stubborn really mean? Who is stubborn? People still perceive what is a characteristic woman, what is a typical man? Bilal grew up as a Muslim. When his parents found out that he was gay, he was no longer safe at home, so he fled. Bilal: “I want to be what I am. Free. This is the message of my work. ”Jasmina Imširović Durić is born in Slovenia, but some of her roots only saw her as a Bosnian, an arrival. Although she tried to conceal this for a while, she later connected with friends who had similar experiences, but the path of self -esteem was not always easy. He is now trying to share his experience with the younger generation through folk dance. Mohamed Akash is a 24-year-old sculptor. He produces statues of Hindu deities, Murtia. But he doesn't like his co -stars, as Akash is a Muslim, not Hindu. He enjoys his profession, for which he has learned as a child. The colleagues are very appreciated by his dedication to this work, which goes beyond religious restrictions. In Bangladesh, there are very common friction between religions and even violence of extremists against Hindu believers, especially during the Durg Pudj holiday. The idea that Muslim would produce Hindu objects of worship is so radicalizing that Akash is always carrying his head for sale. The following film presents us with his story and the reason why the desire to sculpt the deities of a religion, which is not his, so strong that he defies danger. / Nizozemska beseda »stoer« pomeni trdoživ in je umetniška instalacija amsterdamskega vizualnega umetnika Bilala Chahala, s katero opozarja na spol in seksualnost in vse povezano s tem. programme.title: Witnesses: Valentina Kogoj, Mon. / Pričevalci: Valentina Kogoj, pon.
programme.sub-title: Valentina Kogoj, born Mikuš in Budanje, grew up during fascism, war and post -war communist repression. Her childhood was characterized by a lack of, a partisan school and refugee, but also an outstanding teacher who gave her a love of knowledge. / Valentina Kogoj, rojena Mikuš v Budanjah, je odraščala v času fašizma, vojne in povojne komunistične represije. Otroštvo so ji zaznamovali pomanjkanje, partizanska šola in begunstvo, a tudi izjemna učiteljica, ki ji je vlila ljubezen do znanja.
programme.desc: The interviewee recalls that they always supported the partisans at home, mainly because of their language, they wanted a Slovenian school and the end of the Italian authorities. The father was collecting food for the partisans, his mother was active in the anti -fascist front of women (AFZ), had secret meetings. The children were taught to remain silent and hide information - the skills that the interviewee has maintained all their lives. Also, one homeowner who returned home after the war were supposed to capture, torture and kill. His family was never allowed to bury him or find out where he was buried. Who often dreamed of being hunted by the Germans. Anxious dreams also accompanied her in adulthood until she went to Sweden. Like a pressure and graduated in 1953 at the Tolmin School and got a job as a teacher. There, as a teacher, she worked with immigrant children from all over the world, learned languages, learned other cultures, and lived her faith and inner freedom. The Slovene language remained committed, even as a mother. After returning home, she became involved in the prayer community and collected stories from the past. Faith and language were its fundamental guides; The fondest memory, however, remains a plebiscite for an independent Slovenia. / Intervjuvanka se spominja, da so doma vedno podpirali partizane, predvsem zaradi jezika, želeli so slovensko šolo in konec italijanske oblasti. Oče je zbiral hrano za partizane, mama je bila aktivna v Antifašistični fronti žena (AFŽ), imela je skrivne sestanke. Otroke so učili molčati in skrivati informacije - veščine, ki jih je intervjuvanka ohranila vse življenje.Spominja se revolucionarnega nasilja – partizani so v kraju ubili moškega, ki je dvomil v njihovo oboroženo moč. Tudi enega domobranca, ki se je po vojni vračal domov, naj bi zajeli, mučili in ubili. Njegova družina ga nikoli ni smela pokopati ali izvedeti, kje je pokopan.Kot otrok je pogosto sanjala, da jo lovijo Nemci. Tesnobne sanje so jo spremljale tudi v odrasli dobi, vse dokler ni odšla na Švedsko.Kljub pritiskom in je leta 1953 maturirala na učiteljišču v Tolminu in se zaposlila kot učiteljica.V 60. letih je odšla na Švedsko, kjer je ostala več desetletij. Tam je kot učiteljica delala z otroki priseljencev z vsega sveta, se učila jezikov, spoznavala druge kulture ter živela svojo vero in notranjo svobodo. Slovenskemu jeziku je ostala predana, tudi kot mati.Po vrnitvi v domovino se je vključila v molitveno skupnost in zbirala zgodbe iz preteklosti. Vera in jezik sta bila njena temeljna vodila; najlepši spomin pa ji ostaja plebiscit za samostojno Slovenijo.

programme.title: One hundred years from the Carinthian plebiscite, a documentary, Mon. / Sto let od koroškega plebiscita, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Roast Valentin ... Carinthian plebiscite on Sunday 10. October 1920, when Carinthia, cradle of Slovene, lost for us, contemporaries felt as a national disaster. / R: Pečenko Valentin... Koroški plebiscit v nedeljo 10. oktobra 1920, ko je bila Koroška, zibelka slovenstva, za nas izgubljena, so sodobniki občutili kot narodno katastrofo.
programme.desc: The documentary film narrative focuses on the lesser known facts and the political background of the plebiscite. In June 1919, Slovenian politicians met with the most powerful man in the world, US President Woodrow Wilson, but failed to persuade him to abandon the intention of the Carinthian plebiscite. The narrative also reveals lesser -known details of the work and role of General Rudolf Maister in plebiscite time. In particular, it focuses on the operation of the intact plebiscite commission, in charge of performing a plebiscite in Zone A, consisting of the constituencies Rožek, Borovlje, Pliberk and Velikovec. The decisions of Britain's Sydney Capel Peck, the chairman of the commission and its members, Frenchman Charles de Chambruna and Italian Livia Borghese, had a significant impact on the outcome of the plebiscite and marked the fate of Carinthian Slovenes. The film, signed by director and screenwriter Valentin Pečenko, featured renowned domestic and foreign historians and other history examiners, dr. Theodor Domej, dr. Andrej Rahten, Ph.D. Wilhelm Wadl, Marjan Kos, Ph.D. Gregor Antoličič, Augustine Malle, dr. Tina Bahovec, M.Sc. Hanzi Filipič and Horst Ogris. / Dokumentarna filmska pripoved se osredotoči na manj znana dejstva in politično ozadje plebiscita. Slovenski politiki so se junija 1919 sicer sestali z najmogočnejšim človekom na svetu, ameriškim predsednikom Woodrowom Wilsonom, a jim ga ni uspelo pregovoriti, da bi opustil namero o koroškem plebiscitu. Pripoved razkrije tudi manj znane podrobnosti o delovanju in vlogi generala Rudolfa Maistra v plebiscitnem času. Posebej pa se posveti delovanju medzavezniške plebiscitne komisije, zadolžene za izvedbo plebiscita v coni A, ki so jo sestavljali volilni okraji Rožek, Borovlje, Pliberk in Velikovec. Odločitve Britanca Sydneyja Capela Pecka, predsednika komisije in njenih članov, Francoza Charlesa de Chambruna ter Italijana Livia Borgheseja, so pomembno vplivale na izid plebiscita in zaznamovale usodo koroških Slovencev. V filmu, ki ga je podpisal režiser in scenarist Valentin Pečenko, so nastopili priznani domači in tuji zgodovinarji ter drugi preučevalci zgodovine, dr. Teodor Domej, dr. Andrej Rahten, dr. Wilhelm Wadl, Marjan Kos, dr. Gregor Antoličič, Avguštin Malle, dr. Tina Bahovec, mag. Hanzi Filipič in Horst Ogris.

programme.sub-title: Laventure des Marguerite; Two time periods, two girls, one adventure / Laventure Des Marguerite; Dve časovni obdobji, dve dekleti, ena pustolovščina
programme.desc: Marguerites and Margot are twelve years old, each has their own family, friends, problems ... and their time. One lives in 1942, the other in 2020. The mysterious magic chests unexpectedly connect them - and so Margot and Marguerite find themselves in a time that is not theirs. In addition to a sudden journey through time, they are also linked by both lost their fathers - one disappeared in World War II and the other no longer lives at home. Despite the 70-year difference, Marguerite and Margot embark on a big adventure to find their way back to their time, not only exploring family memories and secrets. The Laventure Des Marguerite / French Film, 2019 / Director: Pierre Core / Screenplay: Vincent Cavellier, Benoît Robin Cast: Lile Gueneau, Alice Polo, Clovis Cornillac ...... / Marguerite in Margot sta stari dvanajst let, vsaka ima svojo družino, prijatelje, težave … in svoj čas. Ena živi v letu 1942, druga v 2020. Skrivnostna čarobna skrinja ju nepričakovano poveže – in tako se Margot in Marguerite znajdeta v času, ki ni njun. Poleg nenadnega potovanja skozi čas ju povezuje tudi to, da sta obe izgubili očeta – eden je izginil v drugi svetovni vojni, drugi pa ne živi več doma. Kljub 70-letni razliki se Marguerite in Margot podata na veliko pustolovščino, da bi našli pot nazaj v svoj čas, pri tem pa ne raziskujeta le zgodovine, temveč tudi družinske spomine in skrivnosti.Izvirni naslov: LAVENTURE DES MARGUERITE / Francoski film, 2019 / Režija: Pierre Core / Scenarij: Vincent Cuvellier, Benoît Robin, Stephane Kazandjian / Igrajo: Lile Gueneau, Alice Pol, Clovis Cornillac......

programme.desc: Abby, a Los Angeles lawyer entirely dedicated to work, agrees to participate in a nature retreat with her best friend Rachel. The intention to indulge in relaxation and forget the daily stress, however, clashes with the meeting of Sean, an old friend of Abby, with whom the woman has no longer had contact since the end of high school. An excursion at sunset will be an opportunity to dispel old resentments and make peace but also to develop a new awareness of oneself and others. / Abby, avvocata di Los Angeles interamente dedita al lavoro, acconsente a partecipare a un ritiro nella natura con la sua migliore amica Rachel. Lintenzione di abbandonarsi al relax e dimenticare lo stress quotidiano però si scontra con lincontro di Sean, un vecchio amico di Abby, con cui la donna non ha più contatti dalla fine delle superiori. Unescursione al tramonto sarà loccasione per dissipare i vecchi rancori e fare pace ma anche per maturare una nuova consapevolezza di se e dellaltro.

programme.sub-title: A weekend for adults / Un weekend da adulti
programme.desc: Shawn Spencer has the opportunity of a lifetime: opening a detective agency with his friend Gus. And a psychic, or rather, pretends to be one, in reality just has a great gift for noticing details at all times. / Shawn Spencer ha loccasione della sua vita: aprire unagenzia investigativa con il suo amico Gus. E un sensitivo, o meglio, si finge tale, in realtà ha solo una grande dote nel notare i dettagli in ogni momento.

programme.desc: Shade and Angie must investigate a strange robbery that occurred in a club where Drag Queens perform. As the case becomes more complicated than expected, the two will have the opportunity to re-examine their relationship, arriving at the same conclusion. Mentre il caso diventa più complicato del previsto, i due avranno loccasione di riesaminare il loro rapporto, arrivando alla medesima conclusione. Nel frattempo, Don diventa consigliere comunale.

programme.desc: Among the series most loved by Italian children of multiple generations, many years after the classic cartoon collection, the Smurfs return with a new editorial project. programme.title: Shaun the Sheep / Shaun vita da pecora
programme.desc: On the small farm in the English countryside, the life of Shaun the sheep and the flock that follows her in her exploits is disturbed by the farmer's new acquisition: a small group of very bad llamas. As always, the very strong myopia confuses the farmer about the real state of things and the warnings of the faithful dog Bitzer are of no avail. Shaun with his optimistic approach tends to underestimate new guests, until he realizes he has made them a little too comfortable... / Nella piccola fattoria della campagna inglese la vita della pecora Shaun e del gregge che la segue nelle sue imprese è turbata da un nuovo acquisto del fattore: un gruppetto di lama cattivissimi. Come sempre, la fortissima miopia confonde il fattore sul reale stato delle cose ed a nulla valgono gli avvertimenti del fedele cane Bitzer. Shaun con il suo approccio ottimista tende a sottovalutare i nuovi ospiti, finche si rende conto di averli messi un po troppo a loro agio...

But after the official presentation ceremony the woman disappears leaving the frame empty. Twelve-year-old Jackie will be her first encounter in the chaotic world of the 21st century and the only one who can become a true friend, or rather a BFF! / Al Rijksmuseum di Amsterdam è arrivato il famoso dipinto di Rembrandt che ritrae Oopjen Coppit. Ma dopo la cerimonia ufficiale di presentazione la donna scompare lasciando la cornice vuota. La dodicenne Jackie sarà il suo primo incontro nel caotico mondo del XXI secolo e lunica a poter diventare una vera amica, anzi una BFF!

programme.title: Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: 160 thousand slaves have been freed in Sudan in thirty years. Christians kidnapped by the Arab peoples in the south of the country and deprived of all rights and dignity. But there are those who bring them home. In this episode of Signs of the Times the action and goals of Christian Solidarity International (CSI). / Sono 160mila gli schiavi liberati in Sudan in trent’anni. Cristiani rapiti dai popoli arabi nel sud del Paese e privati di ogni diritto e dignità. Ma c’è chi li riporta a casa. In questa puntata di Segni dei tempi l’azione e i traguardi di Christian Solidarity International (CSI).

programme.title: Patti Chiari (R)
programme.desc: THE GREAT DECEPTION by Alessandra Spataro, Gioele Di StefanoRich heiress, entrepreneur, journalist: the incredible story of a young woman who left behind her debts amounting to hundreds of thousands of francs. Imagine launching yourself into a promising economic activity with what you consider your best friend: a young heiress, friendly and affectionate. Or put yourself in the shoes of the owners of an apartment, lovers of children, who they decide to rent it to a brilliant journalist, separated and with children. Or again: try to identify with a very religious person who has just lost his job and who - coincidence! - is hired by a particularly pious entrepreneur. These are just some of the situations in which many people in the Canton of Ticino have found themselves: they have all had to deal with the same woman, capable of wearing a thousand different masks to convince (and cheat) her victims. A magician of deception, in short, who, despite a complaint, was able to rage for years in the Bellinzona area and beyond. Patti Chiari wants to help you understand which are the warning signs not to be underestimated, which checks are always best to do to protect yourself from those who have no intention of doing you any good. / IL GRANDE INGANNO di Alessandra Spataro, Gioele Di StefanoRicca ereditiera, imprenditrice, giornalista: la storia incredibile di una giovane donna che ha lasciato dietro di se debiti per centinaia di migliaia di franchi Immaginate di lanciarvi in una promettente attività economica con quella che considerate la vostra amica del cuore: una giovane ereditiera, simpatica e affettuosa.Oppure mettetevi nei panni dei proprietari di un appartamento, amanti dei bambini, che decidono di affittarlo a una brillante giornalista, separata e con figli. O ancora: provate a immedesimarvi con una persona molto religiosa che ha appena perso il lavoro e che - coincidenza! - viene assunta da unimprenditrice particolarmente pia.Queste sono solo alcune delle situazioni in cui si sono ritrovate molte persone nel Canton Ticino: tutte hanno avuto a che fare con la stessa donna, capace di indossare mille maschere diverse per convincere (e imbrogliare) le sue vittime. Una maga dellinganno, insomma, che, nonostante una denuncia, ha potuto imperversare per anni nel Bellinzonese e non solo.Patti chiari vuole aiutarvi a capire quali sono i segnali dallarme da non sottovalutare, quali verifiche è sempre meglio fare per tutelarsi da chi non ha nessuna intenzione di farvi del bene.

programme.title: Il giardino segreto
programme.desc: Original title: The Secret Garden Fantastic film by Marc Munden Cast: with Colin Firth, Dixie Egerickx, Julie Walters, Edan Hayhurst, Amir Wilson Country - Year: GB - 2020India, 1947. Mary Lennox, a lively and somewhat spoiled child, loses her parents and is entrusted to the custody of her uncle Archibald Craven, a rich widower who he lives locked up in a sumptuous home in the English countryside, unable to overcome the mourning of the loss of his wife. Mary easily manages to escape the control of the housekeeper, Mrs. Medlock, and discovers a secret garden animated by magical energy on the property. In the castle Mary also meets Colin, Craven's son who spends his days in bed due to an illness and a thousand fears. With the help of the young gardener Dickon, Mary convinces Colin to follow her into the secret garden, certain that the place will help him overcome his illness. / Titolo originale: The Secret Garden Film fantastico di Marc Munden Cast: con Colin Firth, Dixie Egerickx, Julie Walters, Edan Hayhurst, Amir Wilson Paese - Anno: GB - 2020India, 1947. Mary Lennox, bambina vivace e un po viziata, rimane orfana dei genitori e viene affidata alla custodia dello zio Archibald Craven, un ricco vedovo che vive rinchiuso in una sontuosa dimora nella campagna inglese, incapace di superare il lutto per la perdita della moglie. Mary riesce facilmente a sfuggire al controllo della governante, la signora Medlock, e scopre nella proprietà un giardino segreto animato da unenergia magica. Nel castello Mary incontra anche Colin, il figlio di Craven che passa le giornate a letto a causa di una infermità e di mille paure. Con laiuto del giovane giardiniere Dickon, Mary convince Colin a seguirla nel giardino segreto, certa che il luogo potrà aiutarlo a superare la malattia.

programme.title: Albert's garden - The Romans conquered the Alps / Il giardino di Albert - I Romani alla conquista delle alpi
programme.sub-title: I Romani alla conquista delle alpi
programme.desc: In 15 BC, Emperor Augustus launched one of the most ambitious military campaigns of antiquity: the conquest of the Alps. What for centuries had been a natural barrier between the Mediterranean and Central Europe thus became the scene of an extraordinary undertaking, which would mark the destiny of the continent. Recent archaeological investigations conducted in the Canton of Grisons have made it possible to reconstruct, with previously unpublished details, the stages of this advance. Thousands of nails from the sandals of the legionaries, lead bullets used by the slingers and remains of camps over two thousand meters above sea level, on the Settimo Pass, testify to the scope and complexity of the operation. These finds tell of the effort, discipline and ingenuity of men who, thanks to perfect military organisation, were able to face extreme conditions and overcome natural and human obstacles. The conquest of the Alps represented not only a military victory, but also a triumph of Roman logistics and strategy. The opening of new communication routes favored the birth of the province of Rhaezia and contributed significantly to the political and cultural transformation of Europe. Today, archaeological research and discoveries give voice to this page of history, offering new perspectives on an undertaking that continues to arouse interest and amazement. / Nel 15 a.C., limperatore Augusto diede avvio a una delle più ambiziose campagne militari dellantichità: la conquista delle Alpi. Quella che per secoli era stata una barriera naturale tra il Mediterraneo e lEuropa centrale divenne così teatro di una straordinaria impresa, che avrebbe segnato il destino del continente. Le recenti indagini archeologiche condotte nel Canton Grigioni hanno permesso di ricostruire, con dettagli inediti, le tappe di questa avanzata. Migliaia di chiodi provenienti dai sandali dei legionari, proiettili di piombo utilizzati dai frombolieri e resti di accampamenti a oltre duemila metri daltitudine, sul Passo del Settimo, testimoniano la portata e la complessità delloperazione. Questi reperti raccontano la fatica, la disciplina e lingegno di uomini che, grazie a una perfetta organizzazione militare, seppero affrontare condizioni estreme e superare ostacoli naturali e umani. La conquista delle Alpi rappresentò non solo una vittoria militare, ma anche un trionfo della logistica e della strategia romana. Lapertura di nuove vie di comunicazione favorì la nascita della provincia della Rezia e contribuì in modo determinante alla trasformazione politica e culturale dellEuropa. Oggi, le ricerche e le scoperte archeologiche restituiscono voce a questa pagina di storia, offrendo nuove prospettive su unimpresa che continua a suscitare interesse e stupore.

programme.title: Cuntrasts
programme.sub-title: 104 houses for 104 families – Patricia Scarpatetti and her new village / 104 Hauser fur 104 Familien – Patricia Scarpatetti und ihr neues Dorf
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve even more great results in his last year in the mountain bike World Cup. At almost 40 years old, he once again faces the tough professional routine, straining his body, despite knowing that many opponents are even 20 years younger than him and that victories are becoming rarer. Florian Zutt's documentary follows the Graubünden mountain bike legend from the start of the season at the Cape Epic in South Africa, through the World Championships in Valais, up to his last participation in a World Cup race at his home. Once again Nino Schurter gives everything to make his dream of winning in Lenzerheide come true. At the same time, the film allows us to get to know Nino Schurter in his private life, discovering who he is as a person and a father. It's a dive into the environment and family that shaped him. How will the champion be able to detach himself from the life of the professional he has lived for almost 25 years? / Nino Schurter anche nel suo ultimo anno nella Coppa del Mondo di mountain bike vuole raggiungere una volta di più grandi risultati. A quasi 40 anni, affronta ancora una volta la dura routine professionale, sforzando il suo corpo, pur sapendo che molti avversari hanno anche 20 anni meno di lui e che le vittorie diventano più rare.Il documentario di Florian Zutt segue la leggenda grigionese della mountain bike dall’inizio della stagione alla Cape Epic in Sudafrica, passando per i Campionati del Mondo in Vallese, fino alla sua ultima partecipazione a una gara di Coppa del Mondo a casa sua. Ancora una volta Nino Schurter dà tutto per realizzare il sogno di vincere a Lenzerheide.Allo stesso tempo, il film permette di conoscere Nino Schurter nella sua vita privata, scoprendo il suo essere persona e padre. È un tuffo nell’ambiente e nella famiglia che lo hanno plasmato.Come potrà il campione staccarsi dalla vita del professionista che ha vissuto per quasi 25 anni?

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: "Magical art is that which gives us back the marvelous at the heart of everyday life": this is how the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the inspiration - it is precisely the dimension of the magical that the Paganini episode on Sunday 5 October, from 10.30 on RSI LA1, addresses. The "Livermore Svò" - starring Davide Livermore, now an acclaimed opera director - was one of the funniest and wittiest serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episode entitled "Magic Music" alongside the histrionic host, the Orchestra of the Teatro Regio of Turin directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis alternated. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - is a recent French show featuring the pianist duo Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimes/magicians engaged in an evocative dombre theatre. Finally, Fantasymphony is the imaginative symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra conducted by Christian Schumann which - with the subtitle "a concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of songs from films, series and video games that address the theme of the magical and the fantastic. Some examples? The Harry Potter soundtrack written by John Williams, the music by Lorne Balfe for the BBC/HBO series His Dark Materials, the song Breath of Life by Florence and the Machine for the film Snow White and the Huntsman, the famous theme by Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or even the musical suite from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Giona Ostinelli from Ticino. - Livermore Svò - Magical music - Sorcellerie for two pianos - Fantasymphony - A concert of magic and fire / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre. Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Musica magica - Sorcellerie per due pianoforti - Fantasymphony - Un concerto di magia e fuoco

programme.title: Storie
programme.desc: The story of two young people and kindred spirits, leading a queer collective. In a Ticino still closed to the LGBTQIA+ scene, the two carry out a small but intense revolution, made up of DJ sets, performances and acts of daily resistance. Inspired by the cities in which they lived, Buenos Aires and London, they try to transform the reality that surrounds them, bringing the radical energy of the queer metropolises to the heart of Italian Switzerland. The film accompanies them in a crucial moment: the discovery of themselves, the beginning of new loves and the organization of a great event to celebrate the first year of the collective. A dream that collides with economic barriers and prejudices. Dolls on the Block is the intimate and vital portrait of a generation that fights to be seen, between shared dreams and the search for a space to exist. In a historical moment marked by the re-emergence of repressive policies and hate campaigns against the queer community, their commitment takes on an even more urgent force. A documentary by Patrik Soergel For further information we refer you to the following support sites: www.lgbtiq-helpline.ch/it puntodicontattoticino.wordpress.com / La storia di due giovani e anime affini, alla guida di un collettivo queer. In un Ticino ancora chiuso verso la scena LGBTQIA+, lə due portano avanti una piccola ma intensa rivoluzione, fatta di DJ set, performance e atti di resistenza quotidiana. Ispiratə dalle città in cui hanno vissuto, Buenos Aires e Londra, provano a trasformare la realtà che lə circonda, portando nel cuore della Svizzera italiana l’energia radicale delle metropoli queer.Il film lə accompagna in un momento cruciale: la scoperta di se, l’inizio di nuovi amori e l’organizzazione di un grande evento per celebrare il primo anno del collettivo. Un sogno che si scontra con barriere economiche e pregiudizi.Dolls on the Block è il ritratto intimo e vitale di una generazione che lotta per essere vista, tra sogni condivisi e la ricerca di uno spazio dove esistere. In un momento storico segnato dal riemergere di politiche repressive e campagne d’odio contro la comunità queer, il loro impegno assume una forza ancora più urgente.Un documentario di Patrik SoergelPer maggiori informazioni vi rimandiamo ai seguenti siti di supporto: www.lgbtiq-helpline.ch/it puntidicontattoticino.wordpress.com

programme.title: Yukon Mission - Sixth episode / Missione Yukon - Sesto episodio
programme.desc: Increasingly independent and increasingly at ease in the wilderness, the heroes of Mission Yukon have settled into a new camp on the banks of the Hess River. After weeks of intense rain they can finally dedicate themselves to various hunter-gatherer activities, and learn ancient and extraordinary techniques with the help of Kim, an expert on life in the woods. Arianne and Jessica's families have fun together and free their imaginations in the immense spaces of Canada in the sixth and penultimate episode of the series. / Sempre più indipendenti e sempre più a loro agio nella natura selvaggia gli eroi di Missione Yukon si sono sistemati in un nuovo accampamento sulle rive del fiume Hess. Dopo settimane di pioggia intensa possono finalmente dedicarsi a varie attività da cacciatori-raccoglitori, e apprendere antiche e straordinarie tecniche con laiuto di Kim, esperto della vita nei boschi. Le famiglie di Arianne e Jessica si divertono insieme e liberano la propria immaginazione negli immensi spazi del Canada nella sesta e penultima puntata della serie.

programme.title: Cuntrasts
programme.sub-title: 104 houses for 104 families – Patricia Scarpatetti and her new village / 104 Hauser fur 104 Familien – Patricia Scarpatetti und ihr neues Dorf
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve even more great results in his last year in the mountain bike World Cup. At almost 40 years old, he once again faces the tough professional routine, straining his body, despite knowing that many opponents are even 20 years younger than him and that victories are becoming rarer. Florian Zutt's documentary follows the Graubünden mountain bike legend from the start of the season at the Cape Epic in South Africa, through the World Championships in Valais, up to his last participation in a World Cup race at his home. Once again Nino Schurter gives everything to make his dream of winning in Lenzerheide come true. At the same time, the film allows us to get to know Nino Schurter in his private life, discovering who he is as a person and a father. It's a dive into the environment and family that shaped him. How will the champion be able to detach himself from the life of the professional he has lived for almost 25 years? / Nino Schurter anche nel suo ultimo anno nella Coppa del Mondo di mountain bike vuole raggiungere una volta di più grandi risultati. A quasi 40 anni, affronta ancora una volta la dura routine professionale, sforzando il suo corpo, pur sapendo che molti avversari hanno anche 20 anni meno di lui e che le vittorie diventano più rare.Il documentario di Florian Zutt segue la leggenda grigionese della mountain bike dall’inizio della stagione alla Cape Epic in Sudafrica, passando per i Campionati del Mondo in Vallese, fino alla sua ultima partecipazione a una gara di Coppa del Mondo a casa sua. Ancora una volta Nino Schurter dà tutto per realizzare il sogno di vincere a Lenzerheide.Allo stesso tempo, il film permette di conoscere Nino Schurter nella sua vita privata, scoprendo il suo essere persona e padre. È un tuffo nell’ambiente e nella famiglia che lo hanno plasmato.Come potrà il campione staccarsi dalla vita del professionista che ha vissuto per quasi 25 anni?

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.desc: Abby, a Los Angeles lawyer entirely dedicated to work, agrees to participate in a nature retreat with her best friend Rachel. The intention to indulge in relaxation and forget the daily stress, however, clashes with the meeting of Sean, an old friend of Abby, with whom the woman has no longer had contact since the end of high school. An excursion at sunset will be an opportunity to dispel old resentments and make peace but also to develop a new awareness of oneself and others. / Abby, avvocata di Los Angeles interamente dedita al lavoro, acconsente a partecipare a un ritiro nella natura con la sua migliore amica Rachel. Lintenzione di abbandonarsi al relax e dimenticare lo stress quotidiano però si scontra con lincontro di Sean, un vecchio amico di Abby, con cui la donna non ha più contatti dalla fine delle superiori. Unescursione al tramonto sarà loccasione per dissipare i vecchi rancori e fare pace ma anche per maturare una nuova consapevolezza di se e dellaltro.

programme.title: Buckleys Chance
programme.desc: Following the premature death of his father, Ridley is forced to leave New York to move with his mother Gloria to his grandfather Spencer's farm in Australia. Relations between grandfather and grandson are cold, Ridley struggles to settle into the new reality, while Spencer struggles to defend his property from some investors. However, when Ridley mysteriously disappears, forced to flee into the desert in the company of a dingo by two shady individuals, the frantic search for the boy will lead to strengthening family ties. / In seguito alla morte prematura del padre, Ridley è costretto a lasciare New York per trasferirsi con la madre Gloria nella fattoria di nonno Spencer, in Australia. I rapporti tra nonno e nipote sono freddi, Ridley fatica ad ambientarsi nella nuova realtà, mentre Spencer lotta per difendere la sua proprietà da alcuni investitori. Quando però Ridley scompare misteriosamente, costretto a fuggire nel deserto in compagnia di un dingo da due loschi individui, laffannosa ricerca del ragazzino porterà a rinsaldare i legami familiari.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.sub-title: The agriculture of the future - Raid on the Atlantic / L’agricoltura del futuro - Razzia sull’Atlantico
programme.desc: Thousands of civilians killed while waiting for a food parcel. In the Gaza Strip people are not dying only from Israeli bombs. For months now, an increasing number of Palestinians have been targeted as they desperately try to grab food for their families. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, Falò returns to Israel again this time to document the traps of the food aid system, amidst the complaints of international organizations and Israel which denies it. According to the Swiss Philippe Lazzarini, general commissioner of UNRWA, the UN agency for aiding Palestinian refugees: "Gaza is becoming the cemetery of international humanitarian law." / Migliaia di civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi ormai un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo per la propria famiglia. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. A due anni esatti dallinizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, Falò torna di nuovo in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti alimentari, tra le denunce delle organizzazioni internazionali e Israele che nega. Secondo lo svizzero Philippe Lazzarini, commissario generale dellUNRWA, lAgenzia ONU per il soccorso ai profughi palestinesi: "Gaza sta diventando il cimitero del diritto umanitario internazionale."

programme.title: Les Sisters
programme.desc: Marine must face the facts: since Wendy did her professional observation internship at the Pom-les-Bains cinema, her big sister has become mega serious and no longer calculates her little sister! Wendy is falling into nadultry... To give her back the taste for their games, Marine sets up a nadultry treatment... / Marine doit se rendre à l’evidence : depuis que Wendy fait son stage d’observation professionnelle au cinema de Pom-les-Bains, sa grande sister est devenue mega serieuse et ne calcule plus sa ptite sister ! programme.title: Les Sisters
programme.sub-title: My planet of namour / Ma planète de namour
programme.desc: Coming back from school, Marine and her friends Loulou and Nath jump on Wendy and Maxou who were quietly watching TV... There's hot water in the gazpacho: the teacher talked to them about technical climate warming! So from now on, the three pestouilles transform into Eco-Heifers to defend and protect their Planet of Namour! And along the way, we're talking about young teenagers who drink water from plastic bottles, buy polyester clothes and use smartphones with polluting kro batteries... / En revenant de l’ecole, Marine et ses cop’s Loulou et Nath sautent sur Wendy et Maxou qui regardaient tranquillou la tele… Y a de l’eau chaude dans le gaspacho : la maîtresse leur a parlees du rechauffement climat-technique ! Alors à partir de maintenant, les trois pestouilles se transforment en Écolo-Genisses pour defendre et proteger leur Planète de Namour ! Et coller au passage les ados naissants qui boivent de l’eau dans des bouteilles en plastique, achètent des fringues en polyester et utilisent des Smartphones aux batteries kro polluantes…

programme.title: Mystery Lane

programme.sub-title: The big eye / Le grand oeil
programme.desc: Louis XIII is ready to leave some economic powers to Marcel Charmant, the provost of the merchants of Paris. Porthos, superstitious, lets herself... / Louis XIII sapprete à laisser quelques pouvoirs economiques à Marcel Charmant, le prevôt des marchands de Paris. Pour aneantir ce rival irritant, Richelieu sinspire des previsions dun Alchimiste admire par Samuel de Plaindert et cree de fausses predictions pour convaincre le Roi que Charmant est un traître. Porthos, superstitieuse, se laisse ...

programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires
programme.desc: All the lilies in the Louvre disappear... The King's personal guard is moved, because this flower is the symbol of the King of France. But in addition, Henry, the royal gardener, created a new variety of lilies in honor of Olivia de Treville. And he fears that she will soon appear on the thief's list. The mission of dArtagnan and the Three... / Tous les lys du Louvre disparaissent... La garde personnelle du Roi sen emeut, car cette fleur est le symbole du Roi de France. Mais en plus, Henri, le jardinier royal, a cree une nouvelle variete de lys en lhonneur dOlivia de Treville. Et il craint fort de la voir figurer bientôt sur la liste du voleur. La mission de dArtagnan et des Trois ...

programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires
programme.desc: Because his father appears on it, Richelieu has Milady and her henchmen steal a painting that young Louis XIII cherishes. Due to lack of experience, Constance first makes their attempts fail, before... / Parce que son père figure dessus, Richelieu fait voler par Milady et ses sbires un tableau que cherit le jeune Louis XIII. Sa nourrice Constance, impuissante à apaiser son chagrin, part en mission avec dArtagnan et les Trois Mousquetaires pour recuperer le tableau. Par manque dexperience, Constance fait dabord rater leurs tentatives, avant de...

programme.desc: On the Bridgeway High School cheerleading team, the coach, Deb, tends to favor her daughter, Beth, causing the jealousy of the other mothers. Beth appears as a depraved and cruel girl. These videos sow doubt in those around Beth. / Au sein de lequipe de cheerleaders du lycee de Bridgeway, la coach, Deb, a tendance à favoriser sa fille, Beth, provoquant la jalousie des autres mères. programme.title: Les enquetes de Murdoch
programme.desc: The Temperance League is campaigning in the city of Toronto to enforce prohibition. Arthur Slauson, municipal councilor for the Junction district, is found dead, poisoned by the consumption of adulterated alcohol. He was the only one to defend the sale of alcohol at the Junction… / La Ligue pour la temperance est en campagne dans la ville de Toronto pour que soit appliquee la prohibition. Arthur Slauson, conseiller municipal du quartier de la Junction, est retrouve mort, empoisonne par labsorption dun alcool frelate. Il etait le seul à defendre la vente dalcool à la Junction…

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: A post office employee is found dead in his car. Everything suggests that it was a suicide. Jane and Korsak go to her home and come across CJ, a postal service inspection agent, who was to collaborate with the victim on one of his investigations. Jane then asks CJ to help them with theirs. They discover that the victim was involved in drug trafficking and was in fact killed. For her part, Maura indulges in new activities to develop new neuronal pathways in her brain... / Un employe dun bureau de poste est retrouve mort dans sa voiture. Tout laisse à croire quil sagit dun suicide. Jane et Korsak se rendent à son domicile et tombent sur CJ, un agent de linspection des services postaux, qui devait collaborer avec la victime sur lune de ses enquetes. Jane demande alors à CJ de les aider sur la leur. Ils decouvrent que la victime etait impliquee dans un trafic de medicaments et quelle a en fait ete tuee. De son côte, Maura sadonne à de nouvelles activites pour developper de nouvelles voies neuronales dans son cerveau...

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: Jane investigates the apparently accidental death of a wealthy and influential lawyer. The latter would have fallen down her stairs. But upon discovering the lifeless body of the lawyer, the police suspect something other than bad luck. The murderer, intelligent and determined to get away with his perfect crime, begins to play cat and mouse with the team, drawn unwillingly in this direction. Maura unexpectedly grows closer to Hope as she recovers from surgery following a minor procedure. Frankie and Nina's relationship comes to light... / Jane enquete sur la mort apparemment accidentelle dune riche et influente avocate. Cette dernière aurait chute dans ses escaliers. Mais en decouvrant le corps sans vie de la juriste, les policiers soupçonnent autre chose quune mauvaise fortune. Le meurtrier, intelligent et determine à sen tirer grâce à son crime parfait, commence à jouer au chat et à la souris avec lequipe, entraînee malgre elle dans cette direction. Maura se rapproche de Hope, contre toute attente, alors quelle recupère de sa chirurgie après une intervention mineure. La relation de Frankie et Nina eclate au grand jour...

programme.title: Ici tout commence
programme.desc: Filmed in the Camargue, “Here it all begins” is the story of a dynasty of great chefs. programme.title: Noir comme neige
programme.desc: On his birthday, Meyer receives a curious gift: a wooden sculpture of a devil with a demonic and facetious appearance. Meyer smiles when recognizing a typical art object from Bessans, a village in Savoy. He calls Constance, certain she sent him the devil for his birthday. Bad surprise: not only did Constance not know that it was her birthday, but she is grappling with a frozen corpse found on the French coast, locked in an isolated chapel in the middle of the mountains. In the victim's backpack is a carved wooden devil. It is not a murder strictly speaking, but how can we be sure? Did the victim lock himself by accident or did the door close and then get stuck following a gust of wind? Having received the same devil, Meyer decides to get involved in the investigation... / Le jour de son anniversaire, Meyer reçoit un curieux cadeau : une sculpture en bois dun diable à laspect demoniaque et facetieux. Meyer sourit en reconnaissant un objet dart typique de Bessans, un village de Savoie. Il appelle Constance, certain quelle lui a envoye le diable pour son anniversaire. Mauvaise surprise : non seulement Constance ignorait que cetait son anniversaire, mais elle est aux prises avec un cadavre gele retrouve côte français, enferme dans une chapelle isolee en pleine montagne. Dans le sac à dos de la victime se trouve un diable en bois sculpte. Il ne sagit pas dun meurtre à proprement parler mais comment en etre sûr ? La victime sest-elle enfermee par accident ou la porte sest-elle refermee puis bloquee suite à un coup de vent ? Ayant reçu le meme diable, Meyer decide de simpliquer dans lenquete…

programme.title: La profileuse
programme.desc: Called to testify at the trial of Stewart Wilken as a criminal psychologist, Micki would like to take the opportunity to interview this atypical serial killer as part of her research / Appelee à temoigner au procès de Stewart Wilken en tant que psychologue criminelle, Micki voudrait en profiter pour s’entretenir avec ce tueur en serie atypique dans le cadre de ses recherches

programme.title: La profileuse
programme.sub-title: The Phoenix Strangler 1/2 / LÉtrangleur de Phoenix 1/2
programme.desc: Micki Pistorius has to deal with a new affair that upsets her. A man kills women after raping them and abandons the bodies in a sugar cane field. programme.title: Candyman
programme.desc: For as long as they can remember, the inhabitants of Cabrini Green, one of the most unsanitary housing estates in the heart of Chicago, have always been terrorized by a terrible ghost story, passing by word of mouth, about a killer straight out of hell, with a hook for a hand, who could apparently be summoned very easily by anyone who dared, just by repeating his name 5 times in front of a mirror. / D’aussi loin qu’ils s’en souviennent, les habitants de Cabrini Green, une des cites les plus insalubres en plein cœur de Chicago, ont toujours ete terrorises par une effroyable histoire de fantôme, passant de bouche à oreille, où il est question d’un tueur tout droit sorti de l’enfer, avec un crochet en guise de main, qui pourrait apparemment etre convoque très facilement par qui l’oserait, rien qu’en repetant son nom 5 fois devant un miroir.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: Weasy breaks the silo with a DIY boomerang just before the farmer arrives. He is convinced that it was his cow that created this disaster. He decides to sell it to his neighbor to get rid of it. The girls, outraged by the injustice, ask for their father's assistance to prevent this. But Weasy is so focused on his boomerang that he refuses to listen to them. / Weasy casse le silo avec un boomerang bricole juste avant que le fermier arrive. Celui-ci est persuade que c’est sa vache qui a cree cette catastrophe. Il decide de la vendre à son voisin pour s’en debarrasser. Les filles outrees par l’injustice, reclament l’assistance de leur père pour empecher ça. Mais Weasy est tellement focalise sur son boomerang qu’il refuse de les ecouter.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: Weasy acts as a skateboarding teacher, a bit of a showoff, to teach his daughters the art of freestyle tricks. The two twins of the eagle family are curious and observant. Weasy includes them in his class but quickly realizes that one of the two is naturally much more skilled than him with a skateboard. Worried about losing his authority in the matter, Weasy decides to cheat a little. / Weasy s’improvise prof de skateboard, un peu frimeur, pour apprendre à ses filles l’art des figures en freestyle. Les deux jumeaux de la famille aigle sont curieux et observent. Weasy les inclut à sa classe mais s’aperçoit rapidement que l’un des deux est naturellement beaucoup plus doue que lui avec une planche à roulettes. Inquiet de perdre son autorite en la matière, Weasy decide de tricher un peu.

programme.title: La famille Weasy
programme.desc: Weasy and the Cans have an obstacle course tournament with mounts. Weasy controls his sheep very poorly and loses to the cans who are riding a chicken. Between two races, Weasy witnesses an experiment in the farm of the future: scientists are testing electronic chips giving the capacity of one animal to another animal. Weasy steals chips to boost his mount. / Weasy et les canettes font un tournoi de courses dobstacles avec des montures. Weasy maitrise très mal son mouton et perd face aux canettes qui chevauchent une poule. Entre deux courses, Weasy est temoin dune experience dans la ferme du futur : les scientifiques testent des puces electroniques donnant la capacite dun animal à un autre animal. Weasy vole les puces pour booster sa monture.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Casagrandes
programme.sub-title: The uprising of the machines / The duo of heroes / Le soulèvement des machines / Le duo des heros
programme.desc: Ronnie-Anne and her cousins ​​modify Sid's robot to do their chores for them. // Carl is so disappointed after meeting El Falcon that Bobby decides to replace the latter. / Ronnie-Anne et ses cousins modifient le robot de Sid pour quil fasse les corvees à leur place. // Carl est si deçu après avoir rencontre El Falcon que Bobby decide de remplacer ce dernier.

programme.title: The Rebels of the Forest, the series / Les rebelles de la foret, la serie
programme.desc: McSquizzy gets injured because of a prank. Boog and Elliot come to wonder if he is being completely honest about the progress of his recovery. / McSquizzy se blesse à cause dune farce. Boog et Elliot en viennent à se demander sil est tout à fait honnete quant à levolution de son retablissement.

programme.title: The Rebels of the Forest, the series / Les rebelles de la foret, la serie
programme.sub-title: Jojo a bingo / Jojo et Bingo
programme.desc: When Kiki's old circus comes back to town, Boog and Elliot wonder if she wants to visit them. But Kiki is reluctant to reconnect with her past. However, when they learn that Kiki has mysteriously changed her mind and returned to the circus, it makes perfect sense for Boog and Elliot to go see if she is okay. They discover that Kiki is being blackmailed by her former circus partners, Jojo and Bingo. Since Kiki's departure, their numbers and their living conditions have taken a hit. They threaten to show humans what is happening at Freedom Camp if Kiki doesn't help them regain their former success. When Boog and Elliot discover what's going on, they decide to get their "little sister" out of this difficult situation. After a series of adventures Bingo and Jojo find themselves tied up at the top of the trapeze. The two ugly monkeys are now out of harm's way but Boog and Elliot are forced to take the stage in their place and their act is a spectacular success. / Lorsque lancien cirque de Kiki revient en ville, Boog et Elliot se demandent si elle veut leur rendre visite. Mais Kiki est reticente à lidee de renouer avec son passe. Cependant, lorsquils apprennent que Kiki a mysterieusement change davis et quelle est retournee au cirque, il est tout à fait logique que Boog et Elliot aillent voir si elle va bien. Ils decouvrent que Kiki est victime dun chantage de la part de ses anciens partenaires de cirque, Jojo et Bingo. Depuis le depart de Kiki, leur numero, et leurs conditions de vie, ont pris du plomb dans laile. Ils menacent de montrer aux humains ce qui se passe au Camp de la Liberte si Kiki ne les aide pas à retrouver leur succès dantan. Lorsque Boog et Elliot decouvrent ce qui se passe, ils decident de tirer leur "petite sœur" de cette situation difficile. Après une serie de peripeties Bingo et Jojo se retrouvent ligotes au sommet du trapèze. Les deux vilains singes sont desormais hors detat de nuire mais Boog et Elliot sont contraints de monter sur scène à leur place et leur numero remporte un succès spectaculaire.

programme.title: Dragons: Beyond the Shores / Dragons : Par-delà les rives
programme.sub-title: The darkest night / La nuit la plus sombre
programme.desc: Falling into an ambush, Stoik is seriously injured by the cuirassiers, and Harold is torn between his filial duty and his mission as leader of the dragon riders. / Tombe dans une embuscade, Stoïk est gravement blesse par les cuirassiers, et Harold est dechire entre son devoir filial et sa mission de chef des dragonniers.

programme.title: Dragons: Beyond the Shores / Dragons : Par-delà les rives

programme.title: #DansLaToile
programme.desc: What does canvas mean? How does it work? What can we do with it? So many questions and many more that Mitzi and Noah ask themselves, children who have been confronted with the digital world since birth. But they know how to answer it: you just have to look for the information at the source: on the web. / Que veut dire la toile ? De quelle manière fonctionne-t-elle ? Que pouvons-nous faire avec elle ? Autant de questions et encore beaucoup dautres que se demandent Mitzi et Noah, des enfants qui se trouvent confrontes depuis la naissance au monde numerique. Mais ils savent comment y repondre : il suffit daller chercher linformation à la source : dans la toile.

programme.title: #DansLaToile
programme.desc: The Cat explains to Surfeur that digital technology also has an impact on the environment. Indeed, consuming energy is polluting. And by using the Internet, we consume a lot of it. For example, two searches on the Web require as much energy as boiling a liter of water with a kettle! Simply multiply by the number of Internet users to understand that activity on the Web contributes to global warming. What simple actions can you take to reduce digital pollution? So we adopt the right reflexes: we download our favorite films instead of watching them several times online. Save your favorite sites. We choose an alternative and ecological search engine, such as Ecosia, Lilo or Ecogine. And we sort through our messages: by throwing out 30 emails a day, we save as much energy as turning off a light bulb for 24 hours! / Le Chat explique à Surfeur que le numerique aussi a un impact sur l’environnement. En effet, consommer de l’energie, c’est polluant. Et en utilisant Internet, on en consomme beaucoup. Par exemple, deux recherches sur la Toile necessitent autant d’energie que bouillir un litre d’’eau avec une bouilloire ! Il suffit de multiplier par le nombre d’internautes pour comprendre que l’activite dans la Toile contribue au rechauffement climatique. Quels gestes simples pour reduire la pollution numerique ? Alors on adopte les bons reflexes : on telecharge ses films preferes au lieu de les visionner plusieurs fois en ligne. On enregistre ses sites favoris. On choisit un moteur de recherche alternatif et ecologique, comme Ecosia, Lilo ou encore Ecogine. Et on fait le tri dans ses messages : en jetant 30 courriels par jour, on economise autant d’energie qu’en eteignant une ampoule pendant 24 heures !

programme.title: Les metiers
programme.desc: Curious about his friend's dad's job, Bernard asks him: "garbage collector". Cool! But what exactly does he do? Climb on the back of the dump truck for a whirlwind tour of the city! Grimpez à larrière du camion benne pour une tournee de la ville sur les chapeaux de roues ! Que plus une poubelle ne traîne !

programme.title: Les metiers
programme.desc: Curious about his friend's dad's job, Bernard asks him: "costume maker". Brilliant! But what is it actually? programme.title: What's the weather like? / Quel temps fait-il ?
programme.desc: News magazine on the weather in Switzerland and the various news headlines. / Magazine dinfo sur le temps quil fait en Suisse et sur les differents titres de lactualite.

programme.title: In the heart of Switzerland / Au coeur de la Suisse
programme.desc: An icy wind accompanies the troops on the longest stage of the entire route. Between majestic peaks and splendid lakes. Vigilant at every step, we reach the beautiful Buffalora cabin. As night falls, we listen to Romolo tell us about his fascinating Himalayan experiences. / Un vent glacial accompagne les troupes sur letape la plus longue de tout le parcours. Entre cretes majestueuses et lacs splendides. Vigilants à chaque pas, nous atteignons la belle cabane Buffalora. À la tombee de la nuit, nous ecoutons Romolo nous raconter ses fascinantes experiences himalayennes.

programme.title: Doc Portrait
programme.sub-title: Jimmy Somerville, Queer Rebel of British Pop / Jimmy Somerville, rebelle Queer de la Pop Anglaise
programme.desc: With his high voice and his unique stage presence, Jimmy Somerville marked the 1980s by making us dance to forget. First with Bronski Beat, then The Communards, and solo, he has had a lasting influence on English pop without denying his identity. / Avec sa voix aiguë et sa presence scenique unique, Jimmy Somerville a marque les annees 1980 en nous faisant danser pour oublier. Dabord avec Bronski Beat, puis The Communards, et en solo, il a durablement influence la pop anglaise sans renier son identite.

programme.title: Trains like no other / Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: For this new episode in Norway, head to the Fjords, these large arms of the sea which go deep into the land and which are one of the emblems of Norway. The journey begins in a steep train classified among the most beautiful trains in the world: the Flam train. It winds between steep cliffs, waterfalls, tunnels and dizzying ravines to arrive at the bottom of one of the largest fjords in the world... After this journey as dizzying as it is splendid, Philippe Gougler decides to share a moment in a village lost at the bottom of a fjord... a remote village, difficult to access but where the happiness of living the Norwegian way is very palpable. We celebrate Midsommar, the summer solstice around a huge fire. But behind the apparent calm of the fjords, some are threatening... The Geiranger fjord, a world heritage site, is monitored by scientists who expect to one day see a tsunami arrive in the middle of Norway... But it is time for Philippe to take a train back to the city of Bergen, the country's second city. Here, the trains are like Norway, practical and cozy at the same time. In Bergen, the wooden houses are typical of this charming town nestled in a fjord, and in the countryside the wooden houses also reveal themselves as little natural cocoons with their green roofs. Our globetrotter then heads further north, off the fjords, to forgotten islands. Here boats replace trains and fish keep for several years in brine... a treat for the Norwegians but not necessarily for Philippe Gougler and the local seagulls... After this taste and salty stage, Philippe takes a train to the south of the country and discovers that the bar cars are always a nice place to meet new people. Back in a fjord again, Philippe comes across a funny man by chance... With his long beard and his hat, Olaf is a viking deep down. He therefore decided to live like a Viking, surrounded by enthusiasts from all walks of life. / Pour ce nouvel episode en Norvège, direction les Fjords, ces grands bras de mer qui s’enfoncent profondement dans les terres et qui sont un des emblèmes de la Norvège. Le voyage debute dans un train pentu et classe parmi les plus beaux trains du monde : le train de Flam. Il serpente entre falaises abruptes, cascades, tunnels et ravins vertigineux pour arriver dans le bas de l’un des plus grands fjords du monde… Après ce periple aussi vertigineux que splendide, Philippe Gougler decide de partager un moment dans un village perdu au fond d’un fjord… un village recule, difficile d’accès mais où le bonheur de vivre à la norvegienne est bien palpable. On fete le Midsommar, le solstice d’ete autour d’un enorme brasier. Mais derrière le calme apparent des fjords, certains sont menaçants… Le fjord de Geiranger, classe au patrimoine mondial, est surveille par les scientifiques qui s’attendent à voir un jour, un tsunami arriver en pleine Norvège… Mais il est temps pour Philippe de reprendre un train direction la ville de Bergen, la deuxième ville du pays. Ici, les trains sont à l’image de la Norvège, pratiques et douillets à la fois. A Bergen, les maisons de bois sont typiques de cette charmante ville lovee dans un fjord, et dans la campagne les maisons de bois se revèlent aussi comme des petits cocons naturels avec leurs toits vegetalises. Notre globe-trotter part ensuite plus au nord, au large des fjords, sur des îles oubliees. Ici les bateaux remplacent les trains et les poissons se conservent plusieurs annees dans la saumure… un regal pour les Norvegiens mais pas forcement pour Philippe Gougler et les mouettes locales… Après cette etape gustative et salee, Philippe prend un train pour le sud du pays et decouvre que les voitures-bar sont toujours un endroit sympathique pour faire de nouvelles rencontres. De nouveau de retour dans un fjord, Philippe croise par hasard un drôle de bonhomme… Avec sa longue barbe et son bonnet, Olaf est un viking au plus profond de lui. Il a donc decide de vivre comme un viking, entoure de passionnes venus de tous horizons.

It remains to be seen who is the author of this horrible crime, and for what purpose... / Une troupe de theâtre amateur vient mettre en scène la naissance du Christ dans leglise de Brokenwood. Toute la ville est en effervescence. Mais la fete est doublement gâchee quand une relique très precieuse est derobee, tandis que lacteur qui devait jouer Jesus est retrouve mort. programme.title: Le Miracle Suisse
programme.sub-title: Gender fluidity / La fluidite de genre
programme.desc: In 2024, Switzerland won the Eurosong competition with the artist Nemo, whose song highlighted non-binarity. But the theme of gender fluidity has been addressed by Swiss television since the 60s and 70s, with incredible and courageous testimonies. We will also see our two avant-garde comedians François Silvant and Joseph Gorgoni, who created female characters, and we will meet Greta Gratos, a drag queen who appeared on our screens in 1998. We will also listen with pleasure to the many fluid artists who have passed through Switzerland from David Bowie to Boy George via Elton John. The Swiss Miracle, a show for coughs! / En 2024, la Suisse remportait le concours de l’Eurosong avec l’artiste Nemo, dont la chanson a mis en lumière la non-binarite. Mais le thème de la fluidite de genre a ete aborde par la television suisse depuis les annees 60-70, avec des temoignages incroyables et courageux. Nous verrons egalement nos deux humoristes avant-gardistes François Silvant et Joseph Gorgoni, qui ont cree des personnages feminins, et nous retrouverons Greta Gratos, drag queen apparue sur nos ecrans en 1998. On reecoute aussi avec plaisir les nombreux artistes fluides qui sont passes par la Suisse de David Bowie à Boy George en passant par Elton John. Le Miracle Suisse, une emission pour touxtes !

programme.title: Les trois Bricochons

programme.desc: Maestro and Psi can't wait to play sports in front of a TV show. Alas, the remote control is broken. Never mind ! Maestro goes to get another one. programme.title: Once upon a time... these funny objects / Il etait une fois... ces drôles d’objets

programme.desc: Little Pierrette has her arm in a cast. Coming to visit him in the hospital, Maestro slips away to discover how this brilliant invention was born. First impractical wooden splints then a mixture based on egg white, it was only in the 19th century that plaster strips and resin made their appearance... / Petite Pierrette à le bras dans le plâtre. Venu lui rendre visite à lhôpital, Maestro seclipse afin de decouvrir comment est nee cette brillante invention. Dabord attelles de bois peu pratiques puis melange à base de blanc dœuf, ce nest quau XIXème siècle que les bandelettes de plâtre et la resine feront leur apparition...

programme.title: Diane and Gaëtan, it’s now! / Diane and Gaëtan, cest maintenant!

Gaëtan et la jeune Diane deploient toute une palette de propositions pour amuser les enfants. Il y en a pour tous les goûts, toutes les curiosites. Destinee aux enfants jusquà 12 ans et aux familles, ce nouveau rendez-vous propose des activites à realiser à la maison ou à lexterieur.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: It’s the day of the Chapard’or, a major annual competition in which the Chapardeurs compete in teams of two drawn at random. Unfortunately for Arrietty, she falls with Clifden who has never excelled in this competition. No one wants to compete with him, including Pheeta and Gurnard... which tends to deeply upset Clifden. Forced to deal with this “ball and chain”, Arrietty will succeed in motivating him and giving him the desire to prove to everyone that he is indeed capable of winning. / C’est le jour des Chapard’or, une grande competition annuelle dans laquelle les Chapardeurs s’affrontent par equipes de deux tirees au sort. Malheureusement pour Arrietty, elle tombe avec Clifden qui n’a jamais brille dans cette competition. Personne ne veut concourir avec lui, y compris Pheeta et Gurnard… ce qui a tendance à profondement vexer Clifden. Obligee de composer avec ce « boulet », Arrietty va reussir à le motiver et lui donner l’envie de prouver à tout le monde qu’il est bel et bien capable de gagner.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.sub-title: Just in time / Juste à temps
programme.desc: Upon learning that Ludo is preparing a surprise for Marie, Tom sets out to repair an old alarm clock, in order to celebrate Grandmothers' Day... but he can't do it! He calls Arrietty for help. She tries hard to succeed, but she fails... The young Thief will have to invent a subterfuge to get Pod to intervene without arousing his suspicions... / En apprenant que Ludo prepare une surprise pour Marie, Tom se met en tete de reparer un vieux reveil, afin de celebrer la fete des grand-mères… mais il n’y arrive pas ! Il appelle Arrietty à l’aide. Celle-ci se fait fort d’y parvenir, mais elle echoue… La jeune Chapardeuse va devoir inventer un subterfuge pour faire intervenir Pod sans eveiller ses soupçons…

programme.title: Runes
programme.desc: Even though the ritual was interrupted, it left its mark on Hugo. Only Algythe can help him resist the compelling call of the Valkyries who want to take him to join his ancestors! Alas, Loki's awakening also affected the bonesetter who lost her memory... Alice, Turstin, P'tit Golès and Wace will have to open their hearts to save their friends. / Meme si le rituel a ete interrompu, il a laisse des traces sur Hugo. Seule Algythe peut l’aider à resister à l’appel imperieux des Walkyries qui veulent l’emmener rejoindre ses ancetres ! Helas, le reveil de Loki a egalement touche la rebouteuse qui a perdu la memoire… Alice, Turstin, P’tit Golès et Wace vont devoir ouvrir leur coeur pour sauver leurs amis.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Hilda follows the adventures of a little girl with blue hair who is afraid of nothing! She leaves her home to travel through the immensity of a magical wilderness populated by elves and giants to the bustling city of Trollburg, where she meets new friends as well as mysterious creatures who are stranger, and sometimes more dangerous, than she could ever have imagined. / Hilda suit les aventures d’une petite fille aux cheveux bleus qui n’a peur de rien ! Elle quitte son foyer pour voyager dans l’immensite d’une nature magique peuplee d’elfes et de geants jusqu’à la ville bouillonnante de Trollbourg, où elle rencontre de nouveaux amis ainsi que des creatures mysterieuses qui sont plus etranges, et parfois plus dangereuses, qu’elle n’aurait jamais pu l’imaginer.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Steven and the Gems are in a sort of sanctuary in search of the Hourglass of Time, an hourglass with magical power that allows its holder to travel through time. Having taken possession of it, our hero will use it to try to repair a problem that occurred at his father's car wash. Traveling into the past, Steven meets other Stevens and decides to form a group for the open-air concert which is to be organized in the evening. But our hero will quickly realize that playing to change the course of events in this way is a source of trouble. At the end of this adventure the boy will have learned a little more about himself. / Steven et les Gemmes sont dans une sorte de sanctuaire à la recherche du Sablier du Temps un sablier au pouvoir magique qui permet à son detenteur de voyager dans le temps. En ayant pris possession notre heros va sen servir pour tenter de reparer un problème etant intervenu au lave-auto de son père. Voyageant ainsi dans le passe Steven rencontre dautres Steven et il decide de monter un groupe en vue du concert en plein-air qui doit etre organise le soir. Mais notre heros va vite sapercevoir que jouer ainsi à modifier le cours des evenements est source de soucis. Au bout de cette aventure le garçon en aura appris un peu plus sur lui-meme.

programme.title: Signes
programme.sub-title: The Pastoral Care of the Deaf, when Jean-Charles meets Julia / La Pastorale des sourds, quand Jean-Charles rencontre Julia
programme.desc: Since 1988, Jean-Charles Bichet has been pastor to the Community of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing in the canton of Vaud. A committed, scholarly man, Jean-Charles is himself deaf and is preparing to retire. But thanks to Julia Durgnat, a young 28-year-old pastor, succession is assured. Julia is hearing but she took up the challenge of sign language which she practices with ease. Portrait crosses. / Depuis 1988, Jean-Charles Bichet est pasteur auprès de la Communaute des sourds et malentendants du canton de Vaud. Homme engage, erudit, Jean-Charles est sourd lui-meme et s’apprete à prendre sa retraite. Mais grâce à Julia Durgnat, une jeune pasteure de 28 ans, la relève est assuree. Julia est entendante mais elle a releve le defi de la langue des signes qu’elle pratique avec aisance. Portrait croise.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy helps an aerobatics team ahead of a big competition. Caleb struggles to make a decision about Carson while Logan realizes his future. programme.desc: A Switzerland under construction: They are tearing apart neighborhoods and numbering in the hundreds throughout French-speaking Switzerland, construction sites have a major impact on the lives of local residents and businesses.
